prompts.zh: 一位 {{年齡}} 歲的{{性別}}證件照，純白背景，正面直視鏡頭，自然微笑，深色西裝外套與白襯衫，柔和均勻的正面棚燈，無陰影，皮膚紋理真實，五官清晰銳利，頭肩構圖，2 吋規格。
prompts.en: ID photo of a {{age}}-year-old {{gender}}, pure white seamless background, facing camera directly, subtle natural smile, dark suit jacket with white shirt, soft even frontal studio lighting, no harsh shadows, realistic skin texture, sharp facial detail, head-and-shoulders crop, passport format.

prompts.zh: {{職業}}的專業形象大頭照，淺灰漸層背景，四分之三側身、目光看向鏡頭，自信而親和的表情，柔光箱主燈加反光板補光，85mm 鏡頭 f/2.0 淺景深，皮膚質感自然不過度磨皮，商務休閒穿著。
prompts.en: Professional LinkedIn headshot of a {{profession}}, light grey gradient backdrop, three-quarter body angle with eyes to camera, confident approachable expression, softbox key light with reflector fill, 85mm lens at f/2.0 shallow depth of field, natural unretouched skin texture, business casual attire.

prompts.zh: {{主體}}的戶外形象照，黃昏公園背景虛化成柔和光斑，逆光形成髮絲輪廓光，臉部由反光板補上暖光，放鬆的笑容，135mm 長焦壓縮，暖色調，自然真實。
prompts.en: Outdoor portrait of {{subject}}, park at golden hour blurred into soft bokeh, backlight creating a rim light on the hair, face filled with warm bounced light, relaxed genuine smile, 135mm telephoto compression, warm color grade, natural and candid.

prompts.zh: 黑白經典人像特寫，林布蘭側光在頰上形成三角形亮區，深灰背景，眼神堅定，中景頭肩構圖，高細節皮膚與眼睛反光，銀鹽底片顆粒，強烈明暗對比。
prompts.en: Classic black and white portrait close-up, Rembrandt lighting forming a triangle of light on the cheek, deep grey background, steady gaze, head-and-shoulders framing, high detail in skin and catchlights, silver gelatin film grain, strong chiaroscuro contrast.

prompts.zh: 韓系乾淨風格證件照，淺藍或米白純色背景，通透明亮的膚色，柔和無影平光，微微上揚的嘴角，整齊瀏海與淡妝，高清晰度，清爽現代感。
prompts.en: Korean-style clean ID portrait, plain pale blue or off-white background, luminous even skin tone, soft shadowless flat lighting, gently upturned lips, neat hair and light makeup, high clarity, fresh modern feel.

prompts.zh: 電影劇照風格人像，單一側面窗光切過臉部，背景沒入陰影，青橙色調分級，淺景深，細膩的皮膚與布料紋理，2.39:1 寬銀幕氛圍，安靜而有故事感。
prompts.en: Cinematic film-still portrait, single side window light raking across the face, background falling into shadow, teal and orange color grade, shallow depth of field, fine skin and fabric texture, 2.39:1 widescreen mood, quiet and narrative.

prompts.zh: 畢業紀念形象照，穿著學士服與方帽，校園紅磚建築與綠樹背景虛化，午後柔和陽光，開朗笑容，手持文憑，暖色調，青春正向。
prompts.en: Graduation portrait wearing academic gown and mortarboard, campus red-brick building and trees blurred behind, soft afternoon sunlight, bright smile, holding a diploma, warm tones, youthful and hopeful.

prompts.zh: {{年齡}} 歲長輩的溫暖形象照，柔和窗光，深色素面背景，慈祥從容的神情，臉上皺紋與白髮細節保留真實，深色針織衫，尊重且有尊嚴的呈現，中焦鏡頭。
prompts.en: Warm dignified portrait of a {{age}}-year-old elder, soft window light, plain dark background, serene kind expression, wrinkles and grey hair rendered truthfully, dark knit sweater, respectful and dignified, medium telephoto lens.

prompts.zh: {{職業}}站在現代辦公室的落地窗前，城市天際線散景，雙手交疊或抱胸的自信姿態，自然日光加柔和補光，中性色調，企業年報等級的質感，35mm 環境人像。
prompts.en: Environmental portrait of a {{profession}} standing by floor-to-ceiling office windows, city skyline bokeh, confident posture with folded arms, natural daylight with soft fill, neutral palette, annual-report quality, 35mm environmental framing.

prompts.zh: 五到七人的專業團隊合照，站在明亮的開放式辦公室，錯落有致的站位與身高層次，每個人都自然微笑看向鏡頭，均勻柔光，統一的品牌色系服裝，商業攝影質感。
prompts.en: Professional team photo of five to seven people in a bright open-plan office, staggered natural arrangement with height variation, everyone smiling toward camera, even soft lighting, coordinated brand-color outfits, commercial photography quality.

prompts.zh: 講者站在講台上對著麥克風演說的側拍，身後是模糊的簡報投影，舞台聚光燈打亮上半身，手勢自然有力，觀眾席前排剪影，紀實感，高 ISO 現場光。
prompts.en: Speaker at a podium mid-presentation, blurred slide projection behind, stage spotlight on the upper body, natural emphatic hand gesture, silhouetted front row of the audience, documentary feel, available-light high ISO.

prompts.zh: {{職業}}專注工作的紀實特寫，鏡頭聚焦在雙手與工具上，臉部在景深後方微微失焦，工作場域的真實雜訊與細節，側逆光帶出灰塵微粒，紀錄片質感。
prompts.en: Documentary close-up of a {{profession}} at work, focus on the hands and tools, face slightly out of focus behind, authentic clutter and detail of the workspace, side backlight revealing dust motes, documentary photography feel.

prompts.zh: 個人品牌形象照，米色極簡背景，模特兒四分之三側身、手輕托下巴，柔和大面積主燈，中性米棕色系服裝，留白構圖便於後製加字，雜誌編輯感。
prompts.en: Personal-brand portrait, minimalist beige backdrop, three-quarter pose with hand lightly at the chin, large soft key light, neutral taupe wardrobe, generous negative space for overlaid text, editorial magazine feel.

prompts.zh: 品牌識別平拍樣機，米白紋理紙上整齊排列名片、信封與筆記本，斜射晨光投下柔和長影，俯視 90 度平拍，留白充足，質感文具攝影。
prompts.en: Brand identity flat-lay mockup, business cards, envelope and notebook arranged on off-white textured paper, raking morning light casting soft long shadows, 90-degree top-down view, ample negative space, refined stationery photography.

prompts.zh: {{主體}}坐在咖啡廳窗邊，手捧陶瓷咖啡杯，午後窗光斜射在桌面與臉頰上，背景顧客虛化，Kodak Portra 400 底片色調，35mm 抓拍視角，安靜自在。
prompts.en: {{subject}} seated by a cafe window holding a ceramic cup, afternoon light raking across the table and cheek, other patrons blurred behind, Kodak Portra 400 film palette, 35mm candid framing, quiet and unposed.

prompts.zh: {{主體}}在傍晚海灘上赤腳行走，逆光讓髮絲與海浪泛出金邊，長裙隨風揚起，遠方地平線柔和失焦，暖金色調，35mm 廣角帶入天空。
prompts.en: {{subject}} walking barefoot on an evening beach, backlight rimming hair and sea spray in gold, dress lifting in the wind, distant horizon softly out of focus, warm golden grade, 35mm wide framing including the sky.

prompts.zh: 夜晚城市街頭人像，霓虹招牌的洋紅與青色映在臉上與濕潤路面，背景車燈拉成光斑，淺景深，高 ISO 顆粒，賽博龐克都市氛圍，50mm。
prompts.en: Night street portrait in the city, magenta and cyan neon signage reflecting on the face and wet asphalt, car lights blurred into bokeh, shallow depth of field, high-ISO grain, cyberpunk urban mood, 50mm.

prompts.zh: 母親與孩子在家中客廳地板玩耍的自然抓拍，午後陽光透過紗簾灑落，笑聲中的動態瞬間，淺暖色調，柔和對比，居家生活紀實，35mm。
prompts.en: Candid moment of a parent and child playing on a living-room floor, afternoon sun filtered through sheer curtains, mid-laugh motion, soft warm palette, gentle contrast, family documentary style, 35mm.

prompts.zh: 情侶在老街巷弄中並肩行走的紀實照，其中一人回頭笑看對方，斑駁牆面與晾曬衣物為背景，午後硬光與陰影交錯，底片顆粒，日系街拍。
prompts.en: Candid photo of a couple walking side by side through an old alley, one glancing back with a smile, weathered walls and hanging laundry behind, afternoon hard light and shadow, film grain, Japanese street-photography style.

prompts.zh: 清晨臥室的慵懶時刻，{{主體}}裹著米色棉被坐在床邊，晨光穿過百葉窗在牆上畫出條紋，空氣中的灰塵微粒可見，低飽和暖色，安靜療癒。
prompts.en: Lazy early-morning bedroom moment, {{subject}} wrapped in a beige duvet at the edge of the bed, sunrise through venetian blinds striping the wall, dust motes visible in the air, desaturated warm tones, quiet and comforting.

prompts.zh: 健行者站在山稜線上眺望雲海，晨霧在腳下流動，背著登山包，防風外套顏色鮮明，遠景層層山巒，冷藍與暖橘交界的日出光線，24mm 廣角。
prompts.en: Hiker on a mountain ridge looking over a sea of clouds, morning mist flowing below, backpack and brightly colored shell jacket, layered ridgelines receding, sunrise light where cool blue meets warm orange, 24mm wide angle.

prompts.zh: 雨天室內情緒照，{{主體}}靠著佈滿水珠的窗玻璃向外望，窗外街景失焦成一片色塊，冷藍灰色調，柔和低對比，安靜孤獨的氛圍，50mm 淺景深。
prompts.en: Rainy-day interior mood shot, {{subject}} leaning against a rain-beaded window looking out, the street beyond dissolved into color blocks, cool blue-grey grade, soft low contrast, quiet solitary atmosphere, 50mm shallow focus.

prompts.zh: 1990 年代台灣街景中的日常人像，褪色底片色調，輕微漏光與暗角，穿著當年風格的襯衫，背景有老式招牌與機車，柯達過期底片質感，方形構圖。
prompts.en: Everyday portrait set in a 1990s Taiwanese street, faded film palette, slight light leaks and vignetting, period-appropriate shirt, old shop signage and scooters behind, expired Kodak film texture, square format.

prompts.zh: 跑者在清晨柏油路上的側面動態照，汗水在逆光中飛濺並被高速快門凍結，腿部肌肉線條清晰，背景以慢速搖攝拉出線條，高對比，運動品牌廣告質感。
prompts.en: Side-on action shot of a runner on asphalt at dawn, sweat frozen mid-flight by a fast shutter in backlight, defined leg musculature, background streaked by a panning blur, high contrast, athletic brand advertising quality.

prompts.zh: 日系空氣感攝影風格：過曝半格的明亮曝光、極低對比、淡青與奶白色調、柔和無方向性的漫射光、大量留白、輕微朦朧的散景。主題為 {{主體}}。
prompts.en: Japanese airy photography style: half-stop overexposed, very low contrast, pale cyan and milky white palette, soft directionless diffused light, generous negative space, gently hazy bokeh. Subject: {{subject}}.

prompts.zh: 歐美時尚雜誌大片風格：硬質棚燈製造銳利陰影、飽和的單色背景紙、極簡造型、模特兒姿態誇張有張力、Vogue 等級的後製質感。主題為 {{主體}}。
prompts.en: High-fashion editorial style: hard studio strobe with crisp shadows, saturated single-color seamless backdrop, minimal styling, exaggerated confident posing, Vogue-grade retouching. Subject: {{subject}}.

prompts.zh: 中國水墨畫風格：宣紙質地、濃淡墨韻層次、大面積留白、筆觸飛白、僅以硃砂紅點綴印章，構圖遵循留白與呼吸感。主題為 {{主體}}。
prompts.en: Chinese ink-wash painting style: rice-paper texture, graded ink tonality, expansive negative space, dry-brush strokes, a single vermilion seal as the only color accent, composition built on breathing space. Subject: {{subject}}.

prompts.zh: 古典油畫風格：厚塗筆觸與可見顏料堆疊、林布蘭式暗調光源、赭石與土黃為主色、深沉背景、龜裂的清漆質感，博物館館藏氛圍。主題為 {{主體}}。
prompts.en: Classical oil painting style: impasto brushwork with visible paint ridges, Rembrandt-style low-key lighting, ochre and umber palette, deep shadowed background, aged varnish craquelure, museum-collection atmosphere. Subject: {{subject}}.

prompts.zh: 手繪日式動畫電影風格：水彩背景、飽滿的積雨雲、鮮明的草綠與天藍、柔和的角色線稿、溫暖懷舊的光線、細膩的自然環境細節。場景為 {{場景}}。
prompts.en: Hand-drawn Japanese animated film style: watercolor backgrounds, billowing cumulus clouds, vivid grass green and sky blue, soft character linework, warm nostalgic light, richly observed natural detail. Scene: {{scene}}.

prompts.zh: 極簡扁平向量插畫：幾何色塊、無漸層、限定三色的配色、粗細一致的線條、大量留白、適合簡報與網頁的乾淨風格。主題為 {{主體}}。
prompts.en: Minimal flat vector illustration: geometric shapes, no gradients, strict three-color palette, uniform stroke weight, generous white space, clean enough for slides and web. Subject: {{subject}}.

prompts.zh: 蒸氣波美學：洋紅與青的漸層、網格地平線、羅馬石膏像、棕櫚樹剪影、CRT 掃描線與色差、80 至 90 年代電腦繪圖質感。主題為 {{主體}}。
prompts.en: Vaporwave aesthetic: magenta-to-cyan gradients, grid horizon, Roman plaster busts, palm silhouettes, CRT scanlines and chromatic aberration, late-80s computer-graphics texture. Subject: {{subject}}.

prompts.zh: 多層剪紙工藝風格：五到七層錯落紙張堆疊出景深、每層之間有柔和投影、紙纖維質感清晰、飽和度適中的配色、正面平視構圖。主題為 {{主體}}。
prompts.en: Layered paper-cut craft style: five to seven staggered paper layers creating depth, soft drop shadows between layers, visible paper fiber texture, moderately saturated palette, straight-on frontal composition. Subject: {{subject}}.

prompts.zh: 羊毛氈手作模型風格：毛絨纖維質感、圓潤的造型、可見的針戳紋理、柔和的棚拍光、淺色布面背景、微距鏡頭下的溫暖手作感。主題為 {{主體}}。
prompts.en: Needle-felted wool craft style: fuzzy fiber texture, rounded soft forms, visible needle-poke detail, gentle studio light, pale fabric backdrop, macro lens warmth of a handmade object. Subject: {{subject}}.

prompts.zh: 黏土定格動畫風格：可見的指紋與捏塑痕跡、微縮實景搭建、柔和的舞台燈光、飽和的原色、淺景深營造微縮感。主題為 {{主體}}。
prompts.en: Claymation stop-motion style: visible fingerprints and sculpting marks, miniature practical set, soft stage lighting, saturated primary colors, shallow focus reinforcing the miniature scale. Subject: {{subject}}.

prompts.zh: 等距視角像素藝術：16 位元色階、清晰的方格像素、45 度等距投影、柔和的抖色漸層、遊戲場景般的物件配置。主題為 {{主體}}。
prompts.en: Isometric pixel art: 16-bit palette, crisp square pixels, 45-degree isometric projection, subtle dithered gradients, game-scene object arrangement. Subject: {{subject}}.

prompts.zh: 技術藍圖風格：深普魯士藍底、白色細線繪製的正投影圖、標註尺寸線與引線、網格參考線、老舊描圖紙的輕微磨損，精密工程感。主題為 {{主體}}。
prompts.en: Technical blueprint style: deep Prussian blue ground, fine white orthographic linework, dimension lines and leader annotations, grid reference, slight wear of aged tracing paper, precise engineering feel. Subject: {{subject}}.

prompts.zh: 雙重曝光：人物側臉剪影內部融合 {{疊加元素}} 的景象，邊緣柔和過渡，單色或雙色調，背景乾淨，詩意而象徵性的視覺。
prompts.en: Double exposure: a profile silhouette with {{overlay}} blended inside the head, soft edge transitions, monochrome or duotone treatment, clean background, poetic symbolic imagery.

prompts.zh: 移軸微縮效果：高角度俯拍真實場景，上下強烈失焦只留一條清晰帶、飽和度與對比拉高，讓真實場景看起來像塑膠微縮模型。場景為 {{場景}}。
prompts.en: Tilt-shift miniature effect: high-angle view of a real scene, strong blur above and below a single sharp band, boosted saturation and contrast, making the real place look like a plastic model. Scene: {{scene}}.

prompts.zh: 虛擬角色設定圖：一位 {{年齡}} 歲的{{性別}}角色，三視圖排列（正面、側面、背面），日系賽璐璐上色，清晰的線稿，配色標註色卡，白色背景，服裝細節與配件分解說明。
prompts.en: Character design sheet: a {{age}}-year-old {{gender}} character in three views (front, side, back), Japanese cel-shaded coloring, clean linework, palette swatches labeled, white background, costume details and accessories called out.

prompts.zh: 照片級寫實的虛擬人像：細膩的次表面散射皮膚、單根可見的髮絲與眉毛、真實的眼球濕潤反光、柔和棚燈、中性背景、Unreal Engine MetaHuman 等級的渲染。
prompts.en: Photoreal digital human portrait: fine subsurface-scattering skin, individually visible hair and brow strands, wet realistic eye highlights, soft studio lighting, neutral backdrop, MetaHuman-grade rendering.

prompts.zh: 奇幻世界的{{職業}}角色：刻紋精細的盔甲與皮革綁帶、風中飛揚的斗篷、背後是暴風雨天空與遠方城堡、戲劇性的側逆光、電影概念美術質感、全身站姿。
prompts.en: Fantasy {{profession}} character: intricately engraved armor and leather strapping, cloak whipping in the wind, stormy sky and distant castle behind, dramatic side backlight, cinematic concept-art quality, full-body standing pose.

prompts.zh: 近未來賽博龐克角色：局部機械義肢與發光電路紋、防水風衣、雨夜巷弄中的霓虹反光、冷青光與洋紅光交錯、高對比、電影概念設計稿。
prompts.en: Near-future cyberpunk character: partial cybernetic limbs with glowing circuitry, technical raincoat, neon reflections in a rainy alley, cyan and magenta cross-lighting, high contrast, cinematic concept design.

prompts.zh: Q 版三頭身角色：大眼圓臉、簡化的四肢、飽和明亮的配色、粗描邊、柔和的漸層陰影、純色背景、可愛吉祥物風格。角色設定為 {{角色}}。
prompts.en: Chibi three-head-tall character: big eyes and round face, simplified limbs, bright saturated palette, bold outline, soft gradient shading, flat color background, cute mascot style. Character: {{character}}.

prompts.zh: 品牌吉祥物設計：以 {{主題}} 為原型的擬人化角色，圓潤親和的造型、限定四色配色、清楚的辨識輪廓、多種表情小圖並列、白底向量風格。
prompts.en: Brand mascot design: an anthropomorphic character based on {{theme}}, rounded friendly forms, strict four-color palette, strong recognizable silhouette, a row of expression variations, white background vector style.

prompts.zh: 角色表情設定表：同一角色的九宮格表情（開心、生氣、驚訝、難過、害羞、疑惑、得意、疲倦、大笑），風格一致的線條與配色，白底整齊排列。
prompts.en: Character expression sheet: a 3x3 grid of the same character (happy, angry, surprised, sad, shy, puzzled, smug, tired, laughing), consistent linework and palette, tidy layout on white.

prompts.zh: 虛擬偶像的舞台演出畫面：全息投影般的光影、聚光燈與雷射光束、飄浮的光粒子、閃亮的舞台服裝、觀眾席的螢光棒海、動態舞蹈姿勢、廣角低角度。
prompts.en: Virtual idol live-stage scene: hologram-like lighting, spotlights and laser beams, floating light particles, sequined stage costume, a sea of glowsticks in the crowd, dynamic dance pose, low wide-angle view.

prompts.zh: 同一美術風格的職業角色群像：{{職業列表}}，統一的身形比例與配色系統，並排全身站姿，白色背景，扁平插畫風，適合作為系列圖示。
prompts.en: A set of occupation characters in one consistent art style: {{professions}}, unified proportions and palette system, standing side by side in full body, white background, flat illustration, suitable as an icon series.

prompts.zh: 專業交易室畫面：多螢幕牆上顯示紅綠 K 線圖與跳動報價，交易員背影剪影，室內昏暗僅由螢幕藍光照亮，玻璃反射城市夜景，高對比冷色調，商業攝影質感。
prompts.en: Professional trading floor: a wall of monitors showing candlestick charts and streaming quotes, silhouetted trader from behind, dim room lit only by screen glow, city night reflected in the glass, high-contrast cool grade, commercial photography quality.

prompts.zh: 金融市場多空對決的象徵性插畫：一頭金屬質感的公牛與一頭黑色的熊在上升與下降的線圖上對峙，背景為淡色格線與數據流，紅綠對比色，商業雜誌插畫風。
prompts.en: Symbolic illustration of bulls versus bears: a metallic bull and a dark bear facing off across rising and falling chart lines, faint gridlines and data streams behind, red-green contrast, business magazine illustration style.

prompts.zh: 總經數據儀表板 UI 設計圖：深色介面、青綠與琥珀色的資料視覺化、折線圖與熱力圖並置、清晰的數字排版、卡片式模組、細緻的網格對齊，現代金融科技風格。
prompts.en: Macro data dashboard UI: dark interface, teal and amber data visualization, line charts beside a heatmap, crisp numeric typography, card-based modules, precise grid alignment, modern fintech aesthetic.

prompts.zh: 總體經濟概念插畫：象徵通膨的膨脹氣球與象徵利率的向上階梯並列，背景是褪色的鈔票紋理與百分比符號，限定紅、灰、深藍三色，編輯插畫風格。
prompts.en: Macroeconomic concept illustration: an inflating balloon beside an ascending staircase of interest rates, faded banknote texture and percent symbols behind, restricted red, grey and navy palette, editorial illustration style.

prompts.zh: 個人理財主題插畫：一對夫妻在餐桌上看著平板規劃儲蓄，桌上有存錢筒與植栽，溫暖的柔光，米色與草綠色系，親切可信的扁平插畫風格，適合金融品牌文宣。
prompts.en: Personal finance illustration: a couple at a dining table reviewing savings on a tablet, a piggy bank and a potted plant nearby, warm soft light, beige and sage palette, approachable trustworthy flat illustration for financial brand collateral.

prompts.zh: 財經新聞封面圖：巨大的上升箭頭穿過城市天際線，背景為冷藍色調的數據網格，前景留出標題文字空間，強烈透視，商業新聞頻道視覺風格。
prompts.en: Financial news cover graphic: a large upward arrow cutting through a city skyline, cool blue data grid behind, foreground space reserved for a headline, strong perspective, business news channel visual style.

prompts.zh: 市場風險概念圖：無數半透明的肥皂泡泡漂浮在城市上空，其中幾顆正在破裂，泡泡表面折射出股價數字，冷色調搭配一抹警示紅，超現實編輯插畫。
prompts.en: Market risk concept: countless translucent bubbles drifting above a city, several bursting, stock figures refracted on their surfaces, cool palette with a single warning red accent, surreal editorial illustration.

prompts.zh: 資產配置資訊圖：立體感適中的圓餅圖分為股票、債券、現金與另類資產，每塊有清楚標籤與百分比，柔和陰影，米白背景，專業簡報等級的乾淨版面。
prompts.en: Asset allocation infographic: a lightly dimensional pie chart split into equities, bonds, cash and alternatives, each wedge clearly labeled with a percentage, soft shadows, off-white background, clean presentation-grade layout.

prompts.zh: 農曆新年賀圖：朱紅底色搭配燙金紋樣，中央為立體感的春字與盛開的梅花，兩側掛著金色流蘇燈籠，桌上有橘子與糖果盒，中央留白供祝賀文字，喜氣而不俗豔。
prompts.en: Lunar New Year greeting image: vermilion ground with gold foil motifs, a dimensional spring character and blooming plum blossoms at center, gold-tasseled lanterns at both sides, tangerines and a candy box below, clear center space for greeting text, festive but refined.

prompts.zh: {{生肖}}年生肖賀圖：可愛的擬人化生肖角色手持元寶站在紅色圓形背景中，周圍環繞祥雲與金錢紋，剪紙質感的層次，上方預留橫幅文字位置。
prompts.en: Zodiac greeting for the year of the {{zodiac}}: a cute anthropomorphic zodiac character holding a gold ingot on a red circular ground, auspicious clouds and coin motifs around, layered paper-cut texture, banner space reserved above.

prompts.zh: 元宵節夜景：孩童提著紙燈籠走在老街上，四周懸掛數百盞暖黃燈籠，遠方廟宇燈火通明，暖橘色調，柔和光暈與淺景深，溫馨的節慶氛圍。
prompts.en: Lantern Festival night: children carrying paper lanterns along an old street, hundreds of warm amber lanterns overhead, a brightly lit temple in the distance, warm orange grade, soft glow and shallow focus, cozy festive mood.

prompts.zh: 台灣媽祖遶境紀實：陣頭旗幟與神轎在煙霧與鞭炮碎屑中前行，信眾雙手合十跪伏於地，午後強光穿過煙塵形成光柱，高飽和紅金色調，紀實新聞攝影風格。
prompts.en: Mazu pilgrimage procession in Taiwan: temple banners and a palanquin advancing through smoke and firecracker debris, devotees kneeling with hands pressed together, afternoon sun beaming through the haze, saturated red and gold, photojournalistic documentary style.

prompts.zh: 端午節龍舟競渡：鼓手在船頭擊鼓，槳手整齊揮槳濺起水花，龍頭彩繪鮮豔，河岸觀眾旗幟飄揚，高速快門凍結水珠，夏日強烈日光，動感十足。
prompts.en: Dragon Boat Festival race: a drummer at the bow, rowers striking the water in unison with spray flying, a vividly painted dragon head, flags and spectators along the bank, fast shutter freezing droplets, harsh summer sun, high energy.

prompts.zh: 中元普渡場景：長桌上整齊排列供品與插著香的三牲、水果與罐頭塔，白色紙錢與燭火，黃昏時分的柔和光線，莊嚴而寧靜，紀實色調不誇張。
prompts.en: Ghost Month offering ceremony: long tables neatly arrayed with offerings, incense, fruit and stacked canned goods, joss paper and candle flames, soft dusk light, solemn and quiet, restrained documentary color.

prompts.zh: 中秋節團圓場景：大家庭在庭院烤肉，炭火餘燼發出橘光，桌上有月餅與柚子，滿月高掛夜空並帶有薄雲，暖色調，笑語中的自然抓拍。
prompts.en: Mid-Autumn gathering: an extended family barbecuing in a courtyard, orange glow from the charcoal, mooncakes and pomelos on the table, a full moon behind thin cloud, warm tones, candid moment mid-laughter.

prompts.zh: 聖誕節居家場景：裝飾好的聖誕樹掛滿暖黃燈串與紅金球飾，壁爐火光與襪子，窗外飄雪，前景禮物盒堆疊，散景光斑，溫暖飽和的紅綠金配色。
prompts.en: Christmas home scene: a decorated tree strung with warm lights and red-gold ornaments, a lit fireplace with stockings, snow falling outside the window, gift boxes stacked in the foreground, bokeh highlights, warm saturated red-green-gold palette.

prompts.zh: 跨年倒數煙火：城市地標上空綻放多層次煙火，人群剪影仰望，長曝光讓煙火拉出光軌，河面倒映燦爛光影，深藍夜空，廣角低視角。
prompts.en: New Year countdown fireworks: layered bursts above a city landmark, silhouetted crowd looking up, long exposure trailing the light, reflections shimmering on the river, deep blue night sky, low wide-angle view.

prompts.zh: 母親節主題圖：粉色與白色康乃馨花束靠在米白色桌面上，旁邊放著手寫卡片，柔和的側窗光，淺景深，低飽和溫柔色調，上方留白供祝福文字。
prompts.en: Mother’s Day image: a bouquet of pink and white carnations resting on an off-white table beside a handwritten card, soft side window light, shallow depth of field, gentle desaturated palette, blank space above for a message.

prompts.zh: 父親節主題平拍：深藍領帶、皮革錶帶、木質托盤與一杯黑咖啡整齊排列，斜射硬光帶出材質紋理，沉穩的深藍與棕色調，右側留白供文字。
prompts.en: Father’s Day flat-lay: a navy tie, leather watch strap, wooden tray and a cup of black coffee arranged neatly, raking hard light revealing texture, grounded navy and brown palette, right side left blank for text.

prompts.zh: 教師節主題圖：講桌上放著一束花、一疊作業本與紅筆，黑板上有粉筆寫的感謝字樣的模糊背景，午後教室斜光，暖色調，懷舊而溫馨。
prompts.en: Teacher’s Day image: a bouquet, a stack of exercise books and a red pen on a lectern, a blurred chalkboard behind, afternoon light across the classroom, warm tones, nostalgic and heartfelt.

prompts.zh: 早安祝福圖：清晨陽光穿過帶露水的粉色玫瑰與滿天星，柔和光暈與彩虹光斑，背景是淡金色的散景，畫面中央上方留出大片乾淨區域供文字，明亮溫暖，長輩喜愛的飽和度。
prompts.en: Good-morning greeting image: dawn light through dew-covered pink roses and baby’s breath, soft glow and rainbow flare, pale gold bokeh behind, a large clean area in the upper center reserved for text, bright warm and generously saturated.

prompts.zh: 早安圖：雲海之上的日出，金色光芒穿透雲層灑向山巒，前景有一棵孤立的松樹剪影，天空由橘紅漸層到淡紫，大氣磅礡，下方三分之一留白供文字。
prompts.en: Good-morning image: sunrise above a sea of clouds, golden rays piercing through onto mountain ridges, a lone pine silhouette in the foreground, sky graduating from orange-red to soft violet, expansive and majestic, lower third left clear for text.

prompts.zh: 早安圖：木桌上一杯冒著熱氣的咖啡，旁邊有小盆綠植與翻開的書，晨光從左側斜射進來投下柔和長影，暖米色調，右上方大片留白，質感清新不俗氣。
prompts.en: Good-morning image: a steaming cup of coffee on a wooden table beside a small potted plant and an open book, morning light raking from the left casting long soft shadows, warm beige palette, generous clear space upper right, fresh and tasteful.

prompts.zh: 祝福圖：清晨池塘中一朵盛開的粉白蓮花，水面薄霧與露珠，柔和的漫射光，低飽和的青綠與粉色，禪意寧靜，上方留白供「平安喜樂」等祝福語。
prompts.en: Blessing image: a pink-white lotus in full bloom on a misty morning pond, dew on the petals, soft diffused light, muted teal and pink palette, serene and meditative, clear space above for a blessing phrase.

prompts.zh: 晚安圖：深藍夜空中的明亮滿月，薄雲飄過並泛著銀邊，下方是安靜的湖面倒影與遠山剪影，點點星光，寧靜安詳，中央留白供晚安文字。
prompts.en: Good-night image: a bright full moon in a deep blue sky, thin clouds drifting with silver edges, a still lake reflecting below with distant mountain silhouettes, scattered stars, calm and peaceful, center left clear for a good-night message.

prompts.zh: 關懷提醒圖：清晨公園中的太極或散步身影遠景剪影，晨霧與斜射晨光，前景有露水草地，清新的綠色調，畫面下方留白供健康叮嚀文字，溫和不刺眼。
prompts.en: Wellness reminder image: a distant silhouette practicing tai chi or walking in a park at dawn, mist and low sunbeams, dew-covered grass in the foreground, fresh green palette, lower area clear for a health reminder, gentle on the eyes.

prompts.zh: 季節問候圖：{{季節}}的代表性自然景色（如春櫻、夏荷、秋楓、冬雪），構圖統一為中央景物加上下留白，柔和的自然光，飽和適中，可作為系列圖使用。
prompts.en: Seasonal greeting image: a signature natural scene for {{season}} (cherry blossom, lotus, maple, or snow), consistent composition with the subject centered and clear margins above and below, soft natural light, moderate saturation, designed as a series.

prompts.zh: 一週問候圖：以 {{星期}} 為主題，明亮活潑的配色，簡潔的插畫元素（如太陽、咖啡、行事曆），大量留白與清楚的層次，扁平現代風格，適合社群每日發文。
prompts.en: Day-of-week greeting: themed for {{weekday}}, bright cheerful palette, simple illustrated elements such as a sun, coffee cup or calendar, generous white space and clear hierarchy, flat modern style, made for daily social posts.

prompts.zh: 生日祝賀圖：一個插著點燃蠟燭的奶油蛋糕放在木桌上，背景是柔和失焦的暖黃燈串與氣球，淺景深散景光斑，溫暖的金色調，上方留白供生日祝福文字。
prompts.en: Birthday greeting image: a cream cake with lit candles on a wooden table, warm string lights and balloons softly blurred behind, shallow-focus bokeh highlights, warm golden grade, clear space above for a birthday message.

prompts.zh: 歡樂生日派對圖：漂浮的彩色氣球、飛散的紙花與彩帶、閃亮的金色點綴，明亮的粉藍黃配色，白色乾淨背景，中央留出圓形空間放置文字，活潑而不雜亂。
prompts.en: Festive birthday graphic: floating colored balloons, scattered confetti and streamers, gold accents, bright pink-blue-yellow palette, clean white background, a circular clear area at center for text, lively but uncluttered.

prompts.zh: 祝壽圖：紅金色底搭配壽桃、松鶴與如意雲紋，中央為圓形壽字紋樣，邊框以傳統回紋裝飾，端莊喜氣，中央留白供祝壽文字，傳統工藝質感。
prompts.en: Longevity birthday image: red and gold ground with peaches, cranes and pine, auspicious cloud motifs, a circular longevity emblem at center, traditional key-fret border, dignified and celebratory, center reserved for text, traditional craft finish.

prompts.zh: 兒童生日插畫：可愛的動物角色戴著派對帽圍著蛋糕慶祝，柔和的粉彩配色，圓潤的插畫線條，天真歡樂的氛圍，上下留白供姓名與年齡文字。
prompts.en: Children’s birthday illustration: cute animal characters in party hats gathered around a cake, soft pastel palette, rounded friendly linework, joyful innocent mood, margins above and below for a name and age.

prompts.zh: 週年紀念視覺：深墨綠底色搭配燙金的細線框與 {{數字}} 週年字樣，中央有幾何線條組成的簡約徽章，極簡留白，高級質感，適合品牌或婚姻紀念。
prompts.en: Anniversary visual: deep forest-green ground with a gold hairline frame and a {{number}}-year mark, a minimal geometric badge at center, restrained white space, premium finish, suitable for a brand or wedding anniversary.

prompts.zh: 開幕誌慶圖：紅金色系的花籃與綵球，背景為新店面模糊光影，飄落的金色紙花，喜氣但版面乾淨，中央大片留白供店名與賀詞。
prompts.en: Grand-opening congratulation image: red and gold flower baskets and celebration balls, a new storefront softly blurred behind, gold confetti falling, festive yet clean layout, large clear center for the shop name and message.

prompts.zh: 電商主圖：{{商品}}置於純白無縫背景中央，均勻柔和的環繞打光消除硬陰影，僅保留淡淡的接地投影，商品邊緣銳利清晰，色彩還原準確，正面 45 度視角。
prompts.en: E-commerce hero shot: {{product}} centered on a pure white seamless background, even wrapped soft lighting eliminating harsh shadows, only a faint contact shadow, crisp product edges, accurate color, three-quarter front angle.

prompts.zh: 商品情境照：{{商品}}自然地放置在木質桌面上，旁邊有相關的生活道具與一株綠植，斜射窗光帶出材質細節，淺景深，暖色調，真實可用的生活感。
prompts.en: Lifestyle product shot: {{product}} placed naturally on a wooden surface with related props and a small plant, raking window light revealing material detail, shallow depth of field, warm palette, believable everyday context.

prompts.zh: 飲品動態商品照：{{商品}}在液體飛濺中懸浮，水花以高速閃燈凍結成清晰水珠與冠狀，深色漸層背景，強烈邊緣光勾勒瓶身，商業廣告等級。
prompts.en: Dynamic beverage shot: {{product}} suspended amid a liquid splash frozen by high-speed flash into crisp droplets and crowns, dark gradient background, strong rim light defining the bottle, advertising-grade quality.

prompts.zh: 極簡商品視覺：{{商品}}放在圓柱形石材台座上，背景為單一柔和色塊，硬光投下乾淨的幾何長影，低飽和的莫蘭迪配色，大量留白，高級精品感。
prompts.en: Minimal product visual: {{product}} on a cylindrical stone plinth, single soft color-field background, hard light casting a clean geometric shadow, muted Morandi palette, generous negative space, premium editorial feel.

prompts.zh: 俯視平拍組合圖：{{商品}}與相關配件在中性色背景上以網格對齊整齊排列，均勻無影平光，90 度正俯視，構圖對稱有秩序，適合作為系列展示。
prompts.en: Top-down flat-lay: {{product}} and its accessories aligned on a grid over a neutral background, even shadowless lighting, straight 90-degree overhead view, symmetrical orderly composition, ideal for a range display.

prompts.zh: 使用情境照：一雙手正在使用 {{商品}}，鏡頭聚焦在手與產品接觸的細節，背景是模糊的真實使用環境，自然側光，皮膚與材質紋理清楚，真實可信。
prompts.en: In-use shot: a pair of hands operating {{product}}, focus on the contact point between hand and product, real environment blurred behind, natural side light, clear skin and material texture, credible and unstaged.

prompts.zh: 包裝設計樣機：{{商品}}的紙盒與軟袋並排立於淺灰背景，柔和大面積主燈加輕微邊緣光，正面標籤清晰可讀，材質有真實的紙纖維與霧面質感，設計提案等級。
prompts.en: Packaging mockup: the carton and pouch for {{product}} standing side by side on a light grey ground, large soft key light with gentle rim, front label crisply legible, realistic paper fiber and matte finish, presentation-ready.

prompts.zh: 節慶促銷主視覺：{{商品}}被 {{節慶}} 元素環繞，飽和明亮的配色，放射狀背景強調焦點，留出角落區塊放折扣標籤，活潑吸睛但保持商品清晰。
prompts.en: Seasonal promotion key visual: {{product}} surrounded by {{festival}} elements, bright saturated palette, radial background drawing focus inward, a corner block left free for a discount badge, eye-catching while keeping the product clear.

prompts.zh: 美食特寫：一碗剛上桌的 {{料理}}，可見的蒸氣裊裊上升，逆側光讓湯汁與油光閃亮，食材層次分明，深色木桌與粗陶碗，淺景深，暖色調，食慾感強烈。
prompts.en: Food close-up: a freshly served bowl of {{dish}}, visible steam rising, back-side light making the broth and sheen glisten, clearly layered ingredients, dark wood table and rustic ceramic bowl, shallow depth of field, warm grade, highly appetizing.

prompts.zh: 俯視餐桌平拍：多道 {{料理}} 與配菜、餐具、布巾在深色石紋桌面上錯落擺放，自然窗光從左上斜射，柔和陰影，飽滿的色彩層次，雜誌美食版面感。
prompts.en: Overhead table spread: several dishes of {{dish}} with sides, cutlery and linen arranged across a dark stone surface, natural window light from upper left, soft shadows, rich layered color, food-magazine layout feel.

prompts.zh: 台灣夜市小吃紀實：攤販正在翻炒 {{料理}}，鍋氣與火焰竄起，暖黃燈泡與招牌燈光，背景人潮虛化成光斑，高 ISO 顆粒，真實的煙火氣，35mm 抓拍。
prompts.en: Taiwanese night-market street food: a vendor tossing {{dish}} in a wok with flames leaping, warm bulb and signage light, crowd blurred into bokeh behind, high-ISO grain, authentic bustle, 35mm candid.

prompts.zh: 甜點精緻特寫：一塊 {{甜點}} 放在素色瓷盤上，微距鏡頭捕捉層次與碎屑細節，柔和的大面積側光，淺灰粉背景，低飽和高質感，精品甜點店形象。
prompts.en: Refined dessert close-up: a slice of {{dessert}} on a plain porcelain plate, macro lens capturing layers and crumbs, broad soft side light, pale grey-pink background, muted premium palette, patisserie brand imagery.

prompts.zh: 食材原型攝影：新鮮的 {{食材}} 帶著水珠散放在粗麻布與木板上，斜射硬光帶出紋理與立體感，深色背景，低調光線，質樸自然的產地感。
prompts.en: Raw ingredient photography: fresh {{ingredient}} with water droplets scattered across burlap and a wooden board, raking hard light revealing texture and form, dark background, low-key lighting, earthy farm-to-table feel.

prompts.zh: 咖啡特寫：拉花完整的拿鐵在陶瓷杯中，俯視 45 度角，奶泡紋理細膩，杯緣有輕微咖啡漬，木桌與亞麻布，柔和側窗光，暖棕色調，咖啡館氛圍。
prompts.en: Coffee close-up: a latte with intact rosetta art in a ceramic cup, 45-degree overhead angle, fine microfoam texture, a faint stain at the rim, wooden table and linen, soft side window light, warm brown grade, cafe atmosphere.

prompts.zh: 農田空拍圖：整齊的葉菜田在午後陽光下形成規律的綠色條紋，田埂與灌溉溝渠構成幾何線條，遠處有防風林與農舍，垂直俯視，高飽和自然綠，農業紀實。

prompts.zh: 台灣高山雲海日出：層層山稜線在雲海中若隱若現，第一道晨光從側面照亮雲層邊緣，前景有玉山圓柏剪影，冷藍與暖橘的色溫對比，24mm 廣角，高動態範圍。

prompts.zh: 城市藍調時刻天際線：日落後天空呈現深藍紫漸層，建築窗戶亮起暖黃燈光，車流長曝成紅白光軌，河面倒影，長曝光，冷暖對比強烈，高樓細節清晰。

prompts.en: Long-exposure coastline: black volcanic rock in the foreground, seawater smoothed into silky mist, clouds stretched into flowing streaks, dusk pink-violet palette, level horizon, calm and expansive.

prompts.en: Minimal architecture photography: fair-faced concrete and white volumes casting sharp geometric shadows in strong sun, a single cloudless deep blue sky, generous negative space, frontal symmetry, desaturated, serene order.

prompts.zh: 京都街景：石板小徑兩側是木造町屋與暖簾，遠處是五重塔剪影，傍晚燈籠陸續亮起，微雨後的地面反光，低飽和青灰與暖橘，35mm 街拍視角。
prompts.en: Kyoto street: a stone-paved lane lined with wooden machiya and noren curtains, a pagoda silhouette beyond, lanterns coming on at dusk, wet reflective ground after light rain, muted blue-grey with warm amber, 35mm street perspective.
