prompts.zh: 孕婦寫真：側身剪影襯著明亮窗光，雙手輕捧腹部，飄逸的薄紗長裙，低調柔和的打光讓輪廓發亮而細節沒入陰影，米白與膚色調，安靜而有生命力。
prompts.en: Maternity portrait: side silhouette against a bright window, hands resting gently on the belly, flowing sheer gown, low-key soft lighting glowing along the contour with detail falling into shadow, cream and skin tones, quiet and full of life.

prompts.zh: 新生兒寫真：嬰兒蜷曲熟睡在柔軟的羊毛毯上，父母的雙手輕輕環繞，極柔和的漫射光，米白與淺灰色調，微距捕捉細小的手指與睫毛，安靜純淨，無強烈陰影。
prompts.en: Newborn portrait: the baby curled asleep on a soft wool blanket, the parents’ hands cradling gently, extremely soft diffused light, cream and pale grey palette, macro detail on tiny fingers and lashes, quiet and pure, no harsh shadows.

prompts.zh: 街拍穿搭全身照：模特兒行走在城市人行道上，全身入鏡，服裝細節與版型清晰，午後自然光加輕微反光板，背景街景以長焦壓縮虛化，時尚部落格質感，直式構圖。
prompts.en: Street-style full-body outfit shot: a model walking on a city sidewalk, full figure in frame, garment detail and silhouette clearly readable, afternoon daylight with subtle bounce, background compressed and blurred by telephoto, fashion-blog quality, vertical framing.

prompts.zh: 服飾平拍圖：一整套 {{服裝}} 攤平擺放在淺色背景上，衣物折疊整齊、袖口與領口自然堆疊出立體感，均勻無影光，正俯視 90 度，色彩還原準確，電商上架規格。
prompts.en: Apparel flat-lay: a complete {{outfit}} laid out on a light background, garments folded neatly with sleeves and collars arranged to suggest volume, even shadowless lighting, straight 90-degree overhead, accurate color, e-commerce listing standard.

prompts.zh: 時裝週伸展台：模特兒行走中裙擺與布料飛揚，兩側觀眾席沒入黑暗，頂部聚光燈打出強烈的頂光與地面反光，高對比，動感被略慢的快門帶出輕微拖影，時尚新聞攝影。
prompts.en: Runway show: a model mid-stride with fabric in motion, the audience falling into darkness on both sides, hard overhead spotlight and floor reflection, high contrast, a slightly slow shutter leaving subtle motion trail, fashion-press photography.

prompts.zh: 配件質感特寫：{{配件}}放在深色石材上，微距鏡頭捕捉皮革紋理、金屬拋光與縫線細節，單一側向硬光帶出立體感，深色低調背景，精品廣告質感。
prompts.en: Accessory macro: {{accessory}} on dark stone, macro lens capturing leather grain, polished metal and stitching, a single hard side light shaping the form, dark low-key background, luxury advertising quality.

prompts.zh: 美妝特寫：模特兒臉部半邊入鏡，聚焦在眼妝或唇妝的色彩與質地，皮膚有真實毛孔與細絨毛，環形柔光在眼中形成圓形反光，乾淨的單色背景，高解析美妝廣告。
prompts.en: Beauty close-up: half the model’s face in frame, focus on the color and texture of the eye or lip makeup, real pores and fine facial hair visible, ring light forming a circular catchlight, clean solid background, high-resolution beauty advertising.

prompts.zh: {{年代}}年代復古穿搭寫真：符合該時期的髮型、剪裁與配色，場景道具與服裝一致，使用該年代典型的底片色偏與顆粒，輕微暗角，時代感完整而不出戲。
prompts.en: {{era}} vintage fashion portrait: period-accurate hair, tailoring and palette, props and set consistent with the era, film color cast and grain typical of the period, subtle vignetting, fully committed period feel.

prompts.zh: 北歐風客廳室內照：淺色木地板、米白布沙發與淺灰地毯，大面窗引入充足自然光，綠色植栽點綴，簡潔的線條與大量留白，一點透視構圖，色溫偏冷但溫暖舒適。
prompts.en: Scandinavian living room: pale wood flooring, cream fabric sofa and light grey rug, large windows flooding the space with daylight, green plants as accents, clean lines and generous space, one-point perspective, cool white balance yet inviting.

prompts.zh: 侘寂風格室內：粗糙的灰泥牆面、原木橫樑與榻榻米，一只素陶花器插著單枝枯枝，光線從高窗斜射形成柔和光斑，低飽和的米灰與土色，靜謐克制。
prompts.en: Wabi-sabi interior: rough plaster walls, raw timber beams and tatami, a single dried branch in an unglazed vessel, light angling in from a high window into a soft pool, muted grey-beige earth palette, quiet and restrained.

prompts.zh: 工業風咖啡廳內部：裸露紅磚牆與黑鐵管線、水泥地坪、愛迪生燈泡吊燈，木質長桌與皮革座椅，午後陽光穿過大窗形成明暗對比，暖棕與深灰色調，廣角帶入空間感。
prompts.en: Industrial-style cafe interior: exposed brick and black steel conduit, polished concrete floor, Edison bulb pendants, long wooden communal table and leather seating, afternoon sun through large windows creating strong light and shade, warm brown and charcoal palette, wide angle for spatial depth.

prompts.zh: 房產物件照：空屋客廳，垂直線嚴格校正無變形，均衡的曝光讓室內與窗外景色同時清晰，明亮乾淨的白平衡，廣角但不誇張變形，專業不動產攝影規格。
prompts.en: Real-estate listing photo: an empty living room, vertical lines strictly corrected, balanced exposure so both interior and the view outside are readable, bright neutral white balance, wide angle without exaggerated distortion, professional property photography standard.

prompts.zh: 建築室內 3D 效果圖：{{空間}}的寫實渲染，正確的全局光照與柔和陰影，材質有真實的反射與粗糙度，家具比例準確，黃昏時分的暖色人工照明與冷色天光混合，建築視覺化等級。
prompts.en: Architectural interior rendering: a photoreal visualization of a {{space}}, correct global illumination and soft shadows, materials with believable reflection and roughness, accurate furniture scale, dusk mix of warm artificial light and cool skylight, archviz quality.

prompts.zh: 收納整理示範照：小坪數空間中整齊分類的層架與收納盒，物品排列有秩序、標籤清晰，明亮均勻的光線，米白與原木色系，乾淨清爽，適合作為居家整理教學圖。
prompts.en: Home organization photo: a compact space with neatly categorized shelving and storage boxes, orderly arrangement and clear labels, bright even lighting, cream and natural wood palette, crisp and calm, suitable as an organizing tutorial image.

prompts.zh: 設計一張海報，畫面中以粗體黑體中文清楚寫出「{{標題文字}}」，字體端正無錯字，字距均勻。背景為 {{主題}} 的簡潔插畫，限定三色配色，文字與背景高對比，留白充足，直式版面。
prompts.en: Design a poster with the Chinese headline "{{headline}}" rendered in a bold sans-serif face, correct characters, even letter spacing. Background is a clean illustration of {{theme}}, three-color palette, high contrast between type and ground, generous margins, portrait layout.

prompts.zh: 現代極簡海報：畫面中央以超大粗體無襯線英文寫出「{{TEXT}}」，字母部分被幾何色塊裁切但仍可辨識，背景為單一飽和色，右下角有一行小字說明，瑞士平面設計風格。
prompts.en: Modern minimal poster: the words "{{TEXT}}" set in oversized bold sans-serif at center, letters partially cropped by geometric color blocks yet still legible, single saturated background color, a line of small caption type at lower right, Swiss graphic design style.

prompts.zh: 電商促銷標籤圖：畫面中清楚寫著「{{文字}}」，數字放大加粗為視覺焦點，放射狀背景與爆炸框強調，紅黃高飽和配色，圓角標籤造型，四周留白便於去背使用。
prompts.en: E-commerce promo badge: the text "{{text}}" clearly rendered, the number enlarged and bolded as the focal point, radial burst background and starburst frame, saturated red-yellow palette, rounded badge shape, clear margins for cutting out.

prompts.zh: 毛筆書法作品：以行書寫出「{{文字}}」，墨色濃淡有致、筆鋒與飛白清晰，宣紙的纖維質地與輕微暈染，左下角有一枚朱紅印章，大量留白，東方書法美學。
prompts.en: Chinese calligraphy: the phrase "{{text}}" brushed in running script, graded ink density with visible brush tips and dry-brush texture, rice-paper fiber and slight bleed, a vermilion seal at lower left, expansive negative space, classical calligraphic aesthetic.

prompts.zh: 復古絹印海報：{{主題}} 的簡化圖像以三色套印呈現，可見輕微的套版偏移與網點，米黃色紙張質地與邊緣磨損，粗體無襯線標題「{{標題文字}}」置於下方，1960 年代旅遊海報風格。
prompts.en: Vintage screen-print poster: a simplified image of {{theme}} in three-color separation, slight registration offset and halftone dots visible, cream paper stock with worn edges, bold sans-serif headline "{{headline}}" along the bottom, 1960s travel-poster style.

prompts.zh: 活動邀請卡設計：米白紙張上以細襯線字體寫出「{{文字}}」，燙金的細線框與植物線描裝飾，大量留白，對稱置中排版，柔和的自然光展示紙張紋理，高雅簡約。
prompts.en: Event invitation card: "{{text}}" set in a fine serif on off-white stock, gold hairline frame with botanical line drawings, generous white space, symmetrical centered layout, soft natural light revealing the paper texture, elegant and restrained.

prompts.zh: 教學概念插圖：用視覺比喻說明 {{概念}}，扁平向量風格，限定三色，人物為簡化的幾何造型，箭頭與標註清楚，白色背景，一眼就能理解，適合放進簡報。
prompts.en: Educational concept illustration: a visual metaphor explaining {{concept}}, flat vector style, three-color palette, simplified geometric figures, clear arrows and labels, white background, instantly legible, presentation-ready.

prompts.zh: 科學原理示意圖：清楚描繪 {{原理}} 的運作過程，各階段以編號標示並附細引線說明，等距或剖面視角，柔和的技術插畫配色，白底，教科書等級的準確與清晰。
prompts.en: Scientific diagram: a clear depiction of how {{principle}} works, stages numbered with fine leader-line annotations, isometric or cross-section view, soft technical-illustration palette, white ground, textbook-grade accuracy and clarity.

prompts.zh: 歷史場景重現插圖：{{年代}}的 {{場景}}，服裝、建築與器物皆符合史實，柔和的自然光，略帶泛黃的古典色調，畫面資訊豐富但主次分明，博物館解說圖等級。
prompts.en: Historical scene illustration: {{scene}} in {{era}}, clothing, architecture and objects historically accurate, soft natural light, gently aged classical palette, rich detail with clear focal hierarchy, museum interpretive quality.

prompts.zh: 兒童教材插畫：可愛的角色示範 {{主題}}，圓潤的造型與粗線條、明亮的原色配色、簡單背景不干擾主體，情緒正向鼓勵，適合國小低年級教材。
prompts.en: Children’s educational illustration: a friendly character demonstrating {{topic}}, rounded forms and bold outlines, bright primary palette, simple background that doesn’t compete, encouraging positive tone, suited to lower-primary materials.

prompts.zh: 左右對照示意圖：畫面垂直分成兩半，左側為 {{A}}、右側為 {{B}}，兩側構圖對稱、元素一一對應，中央有分隔線，各以一種主色區分，扁平插畫風，一眼看出差異。
prompts.en: Side-by-side comparison graphic: the frame split vertically, {{A}} on the left and {{B}} on the right, symmetrical composition with element-for-element correspondence, a divider at center, each side keyed to one color, flat illustration, differences immediately obvious.

prompts.zh: 時間軸資訊圖：一條水平主軸串連 {{數量}} 個節點，每個節點有年份、小圖示與一行說明，交替配置於軸的上下方，限定雙色加一個強調色，米白背景，清楚有節奏。
prompts.en: Timeline infographic: a horizontal spine linking {{count}} nodes, each with a year, small icon and one line of copy, alternating above and below the spine, two-color palette plus one accent, off-white ground, clear and rhythmic.

prompts.zh: 醫護人員形象照：穿著白袍或手術服，站在明亮潔淨的診間，雙手交疊，溫和專業的微笑，柔和均勻的打光，淺藍與白色調，背景設備適度虛化，可信賴的醫療品牌形象。
prompts.en: Healthcare professional portrait: in a white coat or scrubs, standing in a bright clean clinic, hands folded, warm professional smile, soft even lighting, pale blue and white palette, equipment gently blurred behind, trustworthy medical brand imagery.

prompts.zh: 醫學解剖示意圖：{{部位}} 的立體結構圖，半透明外層顯示內部組織，各構造以細引線標註名稱，柔和的醫學插畫配色，深色漸層背景，解剖學準確，衛教說明用途。
prompts.en: Medical anatomy illustration: a three-dimensional view of the {{part}}, semi-transparent outer layers revealing internal structures, parts labeled with fine leader lines, soft medical-illustration palette, dark gradient background, anatomically accurate, patient-education use.

prompts.zh: 健身訓練照：訓練者在健身房執行 {{動作}}，肌肉線條在側光下清晰立體，汗珠反光，背景器材沒入陰影，深色調加一抹強調色，高對比，運動品牌質感。
prompts.en: Gym training shot: an athlete performing {{exercise}}, musculature defined by side lighting, sweat catching the light, equipment falling into shadow behind, dark palette with one accent color, high contrast, athletic brand quality.

prompts.zh: 健康飲食平拍：均衡餐盤中分區擺放蔬菜、蛋白質與全穀，色彩鮮豔自然，淺色木桌與亞麻布，明亮的自然光，清爽不油膩的質感，營養衛教用圖。
prompts.en: Healthy eating flat-lay: a balanced plate divided into vegetables, protein and whole grains, naturally vivid colors, light wood table and linen, bright natural light, fresh and clean rendering, nutrition-education imagery.

prompts.zh: 冥想放鬆場景：人物盤腿坐在鋪著地墊的安靜房間，晨光透過紗簾漫射，空氣中有細微塵埃，低飽和的米白與淺綠，柔和無陰影，平靜療癒的氛圍。
prompts.en: Meditation scene: a person seated cross-legged on a mat in a quiet room, morning light diffusing through sheer curtains, fine dust in the air, muted cream and pale green palette, soft shadowless light, calm restorative mood.

prompts.zh: 衛教流程圖：以四到六個步驟說明 {{主題}}，每步驟搭配簡化人物圖示與短句，編號清楚、箭頭連貫，淺藍與白的醫療配色，白底，長輩也能一眼看懂的大字級。
prompts.en: Patient-education flowchart: four to six steps explaining {{topic}}, each with a simplified figure icon and a short line, clear numbering and connecting arrows, pale blue and white medical palette, white ground, large type legible for older readers.

prompts.zh: 汽車棚拍形象照：{{車款}}停在深色反光地面上，環繞的長條柔光在車身鈑金上拉出連續的高光帶，輪廓線條清晰，背景為漸層深色，正側 45 度角，汽車廣告等級。
prompts.en: Automotive studio shot: a {{car}} on a dark reflective floor, wrapped strip lighting drawing continuous highlight bands along the bodywork, crisp silhouette, dark gradient background, three-quarter front angle, car-advertising quality.

prompts.zh: 汽車行駛動態照：{{車款}}在蜿蜒山路上高速行駛，追焦拍攝讓背景拉成流動線條、車身清晰，輪胎揚起輕微塵土，黃昏側光，飽和的暖色調，強烈速度感。
prompts.en: Car in motion: a {{car}} cornering fast on a mountain road, panning shot streaking the background while the car stays sharp, light dust off the tires, low golden side light, saturated warm grade, strong sense of speed.

prompts.zh: 台灣街頭機車紀實：一整排機車停靠在騎樓前，招牌與電線交錯，午後強光在地面切出明暗，色彩繁雜卻真實，35mm 紀實視角，濃厚的在地生活感。
prompts.en: Taiwanese street scooters: a row parked along an arcade frontage, signage and overhead wires crisscrossing, harsh afternoon light dividing the pavement, busy but authentic color, 35mm documentary framing, strong local character.

prompts.zh: 復古老車細節特寫：鍍鉻水箱護罩與圓形車燈的微距畫面，烤漆有歲月的細紋與反光，柔和的側逆光帶出曲面，淺景深，低飽和懷舊色調，質感懷舊。
prompts.en: Classic car detail: macro view of the chrome grille and round headlamp, aged paint with fine crazing and reflections, soft back-side light describing the curvature, shallow focus, muted nostalgic palette.

prompts.zh: 城市大眾運輸場景：捷運車廂內部，乘客剪影與窗外飛逝的光帶，冷色的車廂燈光與窗外暖色街燈對比，輕微動態模糊，都市通勤的疏離感，紀實色調。
prompts.en: Urban transit scene: inside a metro car, silhouetted passengers against streaks of light through the windows, cool cabin lighting against warm street light outside, slight motion blur, the quiet detachment of commuting, documentary grade.

prompts.zh: 都市交通空拍：垂直俯視繁忙的十字路口或交流道，車流與斑馬線形成幾何圖案，車輛如玩具般整齊，午後長影增加立體感，高飽和，秩序與韻律感。
prompts.en: Aerial traffic view: straight-down over a busy intersection or interchange, vehicles and crosswalks forming geometric patterns, cars reading like toys, long afternoon shadows adding depth, saturated color, order and rhythm.

prompts.zh: 極簡手機桌布：柔和的雙色漸層由深藍過渡到淡紫，加上細緻的顆粒噪點避免色帶，沒有任何主體物件，中央與上方保持乾淨以免遮住圖示與時間，9:16 直式。
prompts.en: Minimal phone wallpaper: a soft two-tone gradient from deep blue to pale violet, fine grain noise to avoid banding, no focal object, center and top kept clean so icons and the clock stay readable, 9:16 vertical.

prompts.zh: 幾何抽象山脈桌布：層層堆疊的三角形山峰以由深到淺的漸層排列，上方是簡化的大圓日與細緻星點，低飽和的莫蘭迪配色，扁平無質感，構圖平衡，9:16。
prompts.en: Geometric mountain wallpaper: layered triangular peaks graded from dark to light, a simplified large sun disc and fine stars above, muted Morandi palette, flat and textureless, balanced composition, 9:16.

prompts.zh: 深色星空桌布：銀河橫跨畫面上方，前景是低矮的山稜剪影，星點大小層次分明，深藍紫至近黑的漸層，適合深色模式，下方大片留空，9:16 直式。
prompts.en: Dark night-sky wallpaper: the Milky Way arcing across the upper frame, a low ridgeline silhouette below, stars varied in size and brightness, gradient from deep blue-violet to near black, suited to dark mode, lower area left open, 9:16.

prompts.zh: 日式傳統紋樣桌布：青海波或麻葉紋以規律重複鋪滿畫面，細線與素雅的靛藍配色，和紙般的細微質地，無主體、無焦點，適合作為背景不干擾前景，可無縫拼接。
prompts.en: Japanese pattern wallpaper: seigaiha or asanoha motifs tiled across the frame, fine linework and restrained indigo palette, subtle washi texture, no focal point, unobtrusive as a background, seamlessly tileable.

prompts.zh: 抽象流體背景：緩慢交融的彩色墨水在水中擴散，柔和的邊緣與半透明層次，紫粉青三色漸變，高解析度細節，適合作為簡報或網頁的大面積背景，16:9。
prompts.en: Abstract fluid background: colored inks slowly diffusing in water, soft edges and translucent layering, violet-pink-cyan blend, high-resolution detail, suited to a full-bleed slide or web background, 16:9.

prompts.zh: 科技感線條背景：細緻的等距網格線在深色底上延伸至消失點，交點處有微弱發光，一抹青綠色作為強調，大量負空間，冷靜理性，適合資料儀表板背景，16:9。
prompts.en: Tech line background: a fine isometric grid receding to a vanishing point on a dark ground, faint glow at the intersections, a single teal accent, generous negative space, calm and rational, suited to a dashboard backdrop, 16:9.

prompts.zh: 側臉輪廓人像：主體正側面對著明亮背景，臉部細節保留但邊緣被強烈逆光勾出清晰輪廓，深灰背景，低飽和，構圖大量留白於視線方向，安靜克制的藝術人像。
prompts.en: Profile portrait: the subject in strict side view against a bright ground, facial detail retained while the edge is defined by strong backlight, dark grey background, desaturated, generous space in the direction of the gaze, quiet artistic portraiture.

prompts.zh: 雙人形象合照：兩人並肩站立、身體微微朝內，其中一人略靠前形成層次，柔和的大面積主燈，中性背景，服裝色系協調，自然放鬆的表情，商務或家人皆適用。
prompts.en: Two-person portrait: standing shoulder to shoulder angled slightly inward, one placed marginally forward to create depth, large soft key light, neutral background, coordinated wardrobe, relaxed natural expressions, works for business or family.

prompts.zh: 徵才形象圖：年輕團隊在明亮辦公空間中討論，白板上有便利貼，成員自然互動而非看鏡頭，充足的自然光，飽和適中的暖色調，開放友善的企業文化感。
prompts.en: Recruitment image: a young team in discussion in a bright office, sticky notes on a whiteboard, members interacting naturally rather than looking at camera, ample daylight, moderately warm palette, open and welcoming culture.

prompts.zh: 簡報封面用人物照：人物置於畫面右三分之一，身體朝內，左側大片乾淨的單色背景供標題文字，柔和側光，中性色調，構圖為文字預留呼吸空間，16:9 橫式。
prompts.en: Slide-cover portrait: the subject placed in the right third facing inward, a large clean solid-color field on the left for the title, soft side light, neutral palette, composition deliberately reserving space for type, 16:9.

prompts.zh: 旅行紀實照：旅人背著背包站在陌生街頭回望，環境元素說明地點特色，自然光與真實色彩，構圖將人放小以突顯環境，35mm 廣角，有故事感的一瞬間。
prompts.en: Travel documentary shot: a traveler with a backpack pausing to look back on an unfamiliar street, environmental cues establishing the place, natural light and honest color, the figure kept small to emphasize context, 35mm, a moment with a story.

prompts.zh: 髮型形象照：聚焦在髮流、光澤與剪裁層次，柔和的頂光加背光讓髮絲透亮，模特兒微側頭，素色背景，色彩還原準確以呈現真實髮色，美髮沙龍作品集規格。
prompts.en: Hair salon portfolio shot: focus on the flow, shine and layering of the cut, soft top light with backlight making strands glow, the model’s head slightly turned, plain background, accurate color for a true rendering of the hair tone.

prompts.zh: 古風仙俠角色：身著層疊飄逸的長袍與腰帶，長髮與衣袂在風中揚起，手持法器或劍，背景是雲霧繚繞的山巔與月光，冷藍與白的色調加金色點綴，唯美工筆質感。
prompts.en: Xianxia fantasy character: layered flowing robes and sash, long hair and fabric lifting in the wind, holding a sword or talisman, mist-wrapped mountain peak and moonlight behind, cool blue and white with gold accents, ethereal fine-line rendering.

prompts.zh: 機甲設計圖：巨型人形機甲的全身正面圖，裝甲板分件與關節結構清楚，可見螺栓、管線與磨損痕跡，工業配色加警示條紋，白色背景與比例尺人形，硬派工業設計質感。
prompts.en: Mecha design sheet: a full-body front view of a humanoid mecha, armor panel breaks and joint structure clearly defined, visible bolts, cabling and wear, industrial palette with hazard striping, white background with a human silhouette for scale, hard-industrial design quality.

prompts.zh: 長期投資概念插畫：一棵從硬幣堆中長出的樹，年輪與枝葉層次象徵複利成長，背景是柔和的上升曲線，穩重的深綠與金色調，扁平帶輕微質感的編輯插畫。
prompts.en: Long-term investing concept: a tree growing from a stack of coins, rings and branching suggesting compound growth, a soft rising curve behind, grounded deep green and gold palette, lightly textured editorial flat illustration.

prompts.zh: 法說會場景：主管在簡報螢幕前說明財報數字，螢幕上是清楚的長條圖與折線圖，台下記者與投資人的背影，專業的會場燈光，冷藍色調，商業新聞攝影質感。
prompts.en: Earnings call scene: an executive presenting financial figures before a screen showing clear bar and line charts, the backs of reporters and investors in the foreground, professional venue lighting, cool blue grade, business-press photography quality.

prompts.zh: 台灣廟宇建築特寫：色彩鮮豔的剪黏與交趾陶裝飾在屋脊上，龍柱與燈籠細節豐富，藍天為背景，午後強光讓色彩飽和鮮明，仰角構圖突顯宏偉，高細節。
prompts.en: Taiwanese temple architecture: vividly colored jiannian and koji pottery ornament along the roof ridge, richly detailed dragon columns and lanterns, blue sky behind, strong afternoon sun saturating the colors, low angle emphasizing scale, high detail.

prompts.zh: 情人節主題圖：淡粉與奶油色調的柔和背景，玫瑰花瓣與絲帶自然散落，中央有心形的柔焦光斑，大量留白供祝福文字，低飽和溫柔質感，不俗豔。
prompts.en: Valentine’s image: soft pink and cream background, rose petals and ribbon scattered naturally, heart-shaped soft-focus bokeh at center, generous clear space for a message, gently desaturated and tasteful.

prompts.zh: 萬聖節場景：雕刻南瓜燈在門廊上散發橘色暖光，薄霧與落葉，遠處是剪影般的枯樹，深紫與橘色對比，適度的神秘感但保持可愛不驚悚，適合親子活動使用。
prompts.en: Halloween scene: carved jack-o’-lanterns glowing amber on a porch, light mist and fallen leaves, bare trees silhouetted beyond, deep purple against orange, mysterious but kept playful rather than frightening, family-friendly.

prompts.zh: 通用祝福圖：柔和的暖光穿過樹葉在草地上灑落光斑，前景有幾朵小野花，畫面上半部是明亮乾淨的散景區供文字，溫暖低對比，適合各種問候語，長輩友善的明亮度。
prompts.en: General blessing image: warm light filtering through leaves onto grass in dappled patches, a few small wildflowers in the foreground, the upper half a bright clean bokeh area for text, warm low contrast, adaptable to any greeting, comfortably bright.

prompts.zh: 天氣提醒圖：以 {{天氣}} 為主題的簡潔插畫（如雨傘、太陽、雪花），扁平現代風格，明亮的配色，中央大片留白供提醒文字，圖示清楚易懂，適合每日社群發文。
prompts.en: Weather reminder graphic: a clean illustration themed on {{weather}} such as an umbrella, sun or snowflake, flat modern style, bright palette, a large clear center for the reminder text, instantly readable, made for daily social posts.

prompts.zh: 極簡生日卡設計：米白背景上只有一根細長的插著火焰的蠟燭線描圖，細襯線字體寫著祝福，大量留白，柔和的淺灰陰影，低調高雅，適合成人與正式場合。
prompts.en: Minimal birthday card: a single slender line-drawn candle with a flame on an off-white ground, a fine serif greeting, generous white space, soft grey shadow, understated and elegant, suited to adults and formal occasions.

prompts.zh: 寵物生日圖：{{品種}}戴著小巧的生日帽坐在蛋糕前，表情期待又困惑，柔和的暖色燈光與氣球散景，淺景深，明亮活潑的配色，上方留白供祝福文字。
prompts.en: Pet birthday image: a {{breed}} in a small party hat seated before a cake, expectant and slightly puzzled, warm soft lighting with balloon bokeh, shallow focus, bright cheerful palette, clear space above for a message.

prompts.zh: 台式便當俯視照：白飯配上滷排骨、滷蛋、青菜與酸菜分格擺放在鐵盒中，色彩自然不誇張，柔和的頂光，木桌背景，家常真實感，不做過度造型。
prompts.en: Taiwanese lunchbox from above: rice with braised pork chop, marinated egg, greens and pickles arranged in a metal box, natural unexaggerated color, soft top light, wooden table, honest home-style feel without over-styling.

prompts.zh: 手工麵包特寫：剛出爐的 {{麵包}}切開露出蜂窩狀組織，外皮金黃酥脆有裂紋，麵粉灑落在木板上，斜射側光帶出粗糙質地，暖棕色調，職人烘焙質感。
prompts.en: Artisan bread close-up: a freshly baked {{bread}} cut open to reveal an open crumb, golden crackled crust, flour dusted across a wooden board, raking side light bringing out texture, warm brown grade, craft-bakery quality.

prompts.zh: 農夫市集攤位：新鮮蔬果堆疊在木箱中色彩繽紛，手寫價目牌，攤主與顧客互動的自然抓拍，遮陽棚下的柔和散射光，飽和自然的色彩，充滿生活感。
prompts.en: Farmers’ market stall: fresh produce piled in wooden crates in vivid color, hand-lettered price signs, a candid exchange between vendor and customer, soft diffused light under an awning, naturally saturated color, full of life.

prompts.zh: 農作病徵對照圖：左右並列健康與受害的 {{作物}}葉片，微距拍攝葉面紋理與病斑細節，均勻的白光確保色彩準確，白色背景，標註箭頭指出關鍵特徵，農業教學用途。
prompts.en: Crop disease comparison: healthy and affected {{crop}} leaves side by side, macro detail of leaf texture and lesions, even white lighting for accurate color, white background, arrows marking the diagnostic features, agricultural training use.

prompts.zh: 社群引言卡：深色純色背景上以大字級襯線字體排出「{{文字}}」，文字分行有節奏，下方一條細線與署名小字，四周留白充足，安靜有力，1:1 正方形。
prompts.en: Social quote card: "{{text}}" set in large serif type on a solid dark ground, line breaks paced for rhythm, a hairline rule and small attribution below, generous margins, quiet and confident, 1:1 square.

prompts.zh: 前後對比圖：畫面垂直對切，左右兩側為同一場景的前後狀態，構圖與視角完全一致，中央有細分隔線與「Before／After」小標，一致的曝光與色溫，說服力強。
prompts.en: Before-and-after graphic: the frame split vertically showing the same scene in two states, identical composition and viewpoint, a hairline divider with small Before and After labels, matched exposure and white balance, highly convincing.

prompts.zh: 手寫簽名式標誌：以流暢的單筆書寫呈現 {{名稱}}，線條粗細有自然變化，收筆處有輕微飛白，單一深色，白底置中，個人品牌或工作室適用。
prompts.en: Handwritten signature logo: {{name}} rendered in one flowing stroke, natural variation in line weight, a slight dry-brush finish at the terminal, single dark color, centered on white, suited to a personal brand or studio.

prompts.zh: 負空間標誌設計：{{主題A}} 的外形中隱藏著 {{主題B}} 的負空間輪廓，兩者互為圖底，單一實色，極簡幾何，白底置中，設計聰明且一眼可懂。
prompts.en: Negative-space logo: the silhouette of {{A}} concealing the counter-form of {{B}}, the two reading as figure and ground, single solid color, minimal geometry, centered on white, clever yet immediately legible.

prompts.zh: 產品爆炸圖：{{產品}} 的各零件沿同一軸線分離懸浮，間距均勻、順序清楚，細虛線標示組裝關係，等距視角，柔和的棚拍打光與淺灰背景，工業設計提案質感。
prompts.en: Product exploded view: the components of {{product}} separated and floating along a shared axis, even spacing and clear assembly order, fine dashed lines indicating relationships, isometric view, soft studio lighting on a light grey ground, industrial-design presentation quality.

prompts.zh: 低多邊形 3D 場景：{{場景}} 以簡化的多邊形量體構成，柔和的漸層打光與明顯的面塊分界，明亮的粉彩配色，淺景深，浮在乾淨背景上的小島式構圖。
prompts.en: Low-poly 3D scene: {{scene}} built from simplified faceted volumes, soft gradient lighting with visible facet edges, bright pastel palette, shallow depth of field, an island-style composition floating on a clean background.

prompts.zh: 寵物與主人的合照：兩者臉靠近彼此，主人閉眼微笑，寵物直視鏡頭，柔和的窗光，居家背景虛化，暖色低對比，情感真摯不擺拍，50mm。
prompts.en: Pet and owner portrait: faces close together, the owner smiling with eyes closed, the pet looking to camera, soft window light, home interior blurred behind, warm low-contrast grade, genuinely affectionate rather than posed, 50mm.

prompts.zh: 鳥類特寫：{{鳥種}}停在枝頭，羽毛的層次與紋理清晰可見，眼睛銳利對焦並有明亮反光，背景以長焦壓縮成柔和色塊，清晨側光，自然生態攝影質感。
prompts.en: Bird close-up: a {{species}} perched on a branch, feather layering and texture clearly resolved, tack-sharp eye with a bright catchlight, background compressed into soft color by telephoto, early side light, natural-history photography quality.

prompts.zh: 扁平人物插畫：簡化的角色正在 {{動作}}，無臉部細節或僅有極簡五官，圓潤的肢體與統一的線寬，限定四色，白色背景，適合網站與簡報的通用人物圖。
prompts.en: Flat character illustration: a simplified figure {{action}}, faceless or with minimal features, rounded limbs and uniform stroke weight, four-color palette, white background, a general-purpose figure for web and slides.

prompts.zh: 等距 3D 小物件圖示：{{物件}} 以 45 度等距視角呈現，圓潤的邊角與柔和的漸層陰影，明亮的粉彩配色，浮在透明或白色背景上，適合作為系列圖示。
prompts.en: Isometric object icon: {{object}} in a 45-degree isometric view, rounded edges and soft gradient shading, bright pastel palette, floating on a transparent or white background, designed as part of an icon series.

prompts.zh: 拍立得照片質感：方形畫面加下方寬白邊，輕微的過曝與偏黃色偏，柔和的暗角與低對比，邊緣有輕微的化學顯影不均，即時攝影的隨性感。主題為 {{主體}}。
prompts.en: Instant-film look: square frame with a wide white border below, slightly overexposed with a yellow cast, soft vignette and low contrast, uneven chemical development at the edges, the casualness of instant photography. Subject: {{subject}}.

prompts.zh: 長曝光光軌攝影：靜止的主體清晰銳利，周圍的移動光源被拉成連續流暢的線條，深色夜景背景，冷暖光交錯，穩定的構圖與清楚的水平，30 秒曝光質感。
prompts.en: Long-exposure light trails: the static subject rendered sharp while moving lights stretch into smooth continuous ribbons, dark night setting, warm and cool light interweaving, steady composition with a level horizon, the look of a 30-second exposure.

prompts.zh: 玻璃擬態視覺：半透明的磨砂玻璃卡片浮在彩色漸層背景上，玻璃有細緻的邊緣高光與背後模糊，柔和的投影，現代 UI 設計質感，乾淨簡潔。主題為 {{主體}}。
prompts.en: Glassmorphism visual: frosted translucent cards floating over a colorful gradient background, fine edge highlights and background blur behind the glass, soft drop shadows, modern UI aesthetic, clean and uncluttered. Subject: {{subject}}.

prompts.zh: 針筆細密線描：僅以黑色細線的排線與交叉線構成明暗層次，無填色與灰階，白紙背景，極高的線條密度與耐心的細節，古典博物誌插畫風格。主題為 {{主體}}。
prompts.en: Pen-and-ink stipple drawing: tone built purely from fine black hatching and cross-hatching, no fills or greys, white paper ground, extremely dense linework and patient detail, classical natural-history illustration style. Subject: {{subject}}.

prompts.zh: 商品比例對照圖：{{商品}}旁放置一枚硬幣或一隻手作為尺寸參考，兩者在同一平面且對焦一致，白色背景，均勻無影光，清楚傳達真實大小，電商必備輔圖。
prompts.en: Product scale reference: {{product}} beside a coin or a hand for size comparison, both on the same plane and equally in focus, white background, even shadowless light, communicating true size clearly, an essential e-commerce support image.

prompts.zh: 材質細節微距：極近距離拍攝 {{商品}} 的表面，織紋、拋光、縫線或木紋的細節填滿畫面，斜射硬光強調凹凸，淺景深讓邊緣柔化，抽象而有質感的細節圖。
prompts.en: Material macro: an extreme close-up of the surface of {{product}}, weave, polish, stitching or grain filling the frame, raking hard light emphasizing relief, shallow focus softening the edges, an abstract yet tactile detail shot.

prompts.zh: 榮陞誌慶賀圖：深酒紅與燙金的莊重底色，中央是金色綬帶與桂冠環繞的圓形徽記，兩側有向上延伸的細金線與雲紋，畫面中央預留大片乾淨區域書寫「{{賀詞}}」，下方留出署名位置，端莊大器不浮誇，直式構圖。
prompts.en: Promotion congratulation graphic: dignified deep burgundy ground with gold foil, a circular emblem framed by a gold sash and laurel at center, fine gold lines and cloud motifs rising on both sides, a large clean area at center reserved for the message "{{message}}", space for a signature below, stately rather than flashy, portrait layout.

prompts.zh: 就職布達典禮場景：會場講台前的紅色布幔與國旗或機關旗，胸前配戴綬帶的主角與長官握手交接，賓客席在景深後方虛化，正式的會場燈光，沉穩的紅金與深藍色調，紀實新聞攝影質感。
prompts.en: Inauguration ceremony scene: a red drape and institutional flag behind the podium, the honoree wearing a sash shaking hands with a senior official, guests blurred in the background, formal venue lighting, grounded red-gold and navy palette, photojournalistic quality.

prompts.zh: 軍旅退伍紀念圖：軍綠與卡其色調背景，中央是折疊整齊的軍帽、階級章與一枚紀念徽章的靜物平拍，旁邊有一封信與鋼筆，斜射硬光帶出布料與金屬質感，上方留白書寫「{{賀詞}}」，肅穆而溫暖。
prompts.en: Military discharge commemorative image: olive and khaki palette, a still-life flat lay of a neatly folded cap, rank insignia and a commemorative medal at center, a letter and fountain pen beside them, raking hard light bringing out fabric and metal texture, clear space above for "{{message}}", solemn yet warm.

prompts.zh: 退伍歡送合影：一群同袍在營區前並肩搭肩大笑，中央的主角被拋接或被眾人簇擁，午後強烈日光，飽和的軍綠與藍天，動態抓拍非擺拍，青春與情誼並存的紀實感，35mm 廣角。
prompts.en: Send-off group photo: comrades with arms around each other laughing outside the barracks, the honoree hoisted or surrounded at center, strong afternoon sun, saturated olive green against blue sky, candid action rather than a posed line-up, youthful camaraderie, 35mm wide angle.

prompts.zh: 榮退祝福圖：溫暖的米金色背景，中央是一只放下的懷錶與一束向日葵，旁邊散落幾張泛黃的老照片，柔和的側窗光，低飽和的懷舊色調，上方大片留白書寫「{{賀詞}}」，感念而不傷感。
prompts.en: Retirement tribute image: warm cream-gold background, a set-down pocket watch and a bouquet of sunflowers at center, a few faded photographs scattered beside, soft side window light, muted nostalgic palette, generous clear space above for "{{message}}", grateful rather than melancholy.

prompts.zh: 傳統賀匾樣式：深紅木質匾額搭配燙金浮雕邊框，四角有龍紋或回紋裝飾，中央大片留白書寫「{{賀詞}}」四字，兩側有落款位置，正面平視構圖，木紋與金箔質感真實，端莊隆重。
prompts.en: Traditional congratulatory plaque: a deep red lacquered wooden plaque with an embossed gold frame, dragon or key-fret motifs at the four corners, a large clear center for a four-character phrase "{{message}}", inscription space at both sides, straight-on frontal view, realistic wood grain and gold leaf, formal and ceremonious.

prompts.zh: 當選誌慶賀圖：紅金配色的放射狀背景，中央是綬帶與勝利手勢的剪影或桂冠圖樣，飄落的金色紙花，畫面中段留出橫幅區塊書寫「{{賀詞}}」，喜氣醒目但保持莊重，適合花籃卡片與社群發布。
prompts.en: Election victory congratulation graphic: red-gold radial background, a sash and laurel emblem at center, gold confetti falling, a horizontal band in the middle reserved for "{{message}}", celebratory and eye-catching yet dignified, suited to flower-basket cards and social posts.

prompts.zh: 金榜題名賀圖：朱紅與金色的傳統榜單樣式，背景是淡淡的雲紋與墨竹，中央留白書寫「{{賀詞}}」，旁邊有毛筆與硯台的靜物點綴，喜氣中帶書卷氣，直式構圖。
prompts.en: Exam success congratulation: a traditional vermilion and gold results-notice layout, faint cloud motifs and ink bamboo in the background, a clear center for "{{message}}", a brush and inkstone as still-life accents, festive with a scholarly air, portrait layout.

prompts.zh: 喬遷之喜賀圖：明亮的新居玄關，門上掛著紅色緞帶與小花圈，地上有尚未拆封的紙箱與一盆綠植，晨光從門外灑入，溫暖清爽的米白與原木色調，右上方留白書寫「{{賀詞}}」。
prompts.en: Housewarming congratulation: a bright new entryway, a red ribbon and small wreath on the door, unopened boxes and a potted plant on the floor, morning light spilling in from outside, warm fresh cream and natural wood palette, clear space at upper right for "{{message}}".

prompts.zh: 彌月賀圖：柔和的粉藍或粉紅漸層背景，中央是小巧的嬰兒鞋、圍兜與一朵棉花般的雲，極柔和的漫射光，低飽和的粉彩色調，上方留白書寫「{{賀詞}}」，溫柔可愛不甜膩。
prompts.en: Full-moon baby celebration image: a soft pastel blue or pink gradient, tiny baby shoes, a bib and a cotton-soft cloud at center, extremely soft diffused light, muted pastel palette, clear space above for "{{message}}", tender and sweet without excess.

prompts.zh: 康復祝福圖：明亮的窗邊放著一束白色與淡黃的花，旁邊有一杯溫水與摺好的毛毯，晨光柔和灑落，清爽的白綠色調，畫面下方留白書寫「{{賀詞}}」，安定溫和不帶醫療感。
prompts.en: Get-well image: a bouquet of white and pale yellow flowers by a bright window, a cup of warm water and a folded blanket beside, soft morning light, fresh white-green palette, clear space below for "{{message}}", calming and warm without a clinical feel.

prompts.zh: 獲獎表揚賀圖：深藍或墨綠的沉穩背景，中央是一座簡潔的獎座或金色徽章，柔和的邊緣光讓金屬質感立體，細緻的光暈與粒子，下方留白書寫「{{賀詞}}」，專業有質感，適合公司內部表揚。
prompts.en: Award recognition graphic: a grounded navy or deep green background, a clean trophy or gold medallion at center, soft rim light shaping the metal, subtle glow and particles, clear space below for "{{message}}", polished and professional, suited to internal company recognition.

prompts.zh: 結婚誌喜賀卡：米白紙張質感搭配燙金的植物線描與細框，中央留白書寫「{{賀詞}}」，右下角有一對交疊的戒指線稿，對稱置中排版，柔和自然光展現紙紋，典雅簡約不俗豔。
prompts.en: Wedding congratulation card: off-white paper stock with gold botanical line art and a fine frame, a clear center for "{{message}}", a pair of interlocking rings drawn at lower right, symmetrical centered layout, soft natural light revealing the paper texture, elegant and restrained.

prompts.zh: 同一位角色的上班日：合身的襯衫與西裝外套，肩背托特包，站在清晨的辦公大樓前，柔和的側向晨光，都市背景淺景深虛化，半身構圖，專業而放鬆的表情。
prompts.en: The same character on a workday: a fitted shirt and blazer, tote bag on the shoulder, standing outside an office building at dawn, soft side morning light, urban background thrown out of focus, half-body framing, professional and at ease.

prompts.zh: 同一位角色的居家時刻：寬鬆的棉質家居服與拖鞋，蜷在沙發上捧著馬克杯，午後窗光柔和灑落，暖色低對比，房間背景微微失焦，放鬆自在的神情。
prompts.en: The same character at home: loose cotton loungewear and slippers, curled on a sofa holding a mug, soft afternoon window light, warm low contrast, the room gently out of focus, relaxed and unguarded.

prompts.zh: 同一位角色的運動時刻：機能性運動背心與短褲，額頭有汗珠，在戶外跑道或健身房，強烈的側光勾勒身形，高對比冷色調，動態姿勢，專注有活力。
prompts.en: The same character working out: technical tank top and shorts, sweat on the forehead, on an outdoor track or in a gym, strong side light defining the form, high-contrast cool grade, dynamic pose, focused and energetic.

prompts.zh: 同一位角色的正式場合：剪裁俐落的禮服或西裝，配戴簡約飾品，站在昏黃燈光的宴會廳中，柔和的散景光斑，暖金色調，優雅端莊的站姿與微笑。
prompts.en: The same character at a formal event: a sharply tailored gown or suit with minimal jewelry, standing in a warmly lit banquet hall, soft bokeh highlights, warm golden grade, elegant posture and a composed smile.

prompts.zh: 同一位角色的雨天：撐著透明傘穿著風衣，站在濕潤反光的街道上，霓虹與路燈在水面倒映，冷藍色調帶一抹暖橘，淺景深，安靜的情緒感。
prompts.en: The same character in the rain: a clear umbrella and trench coat on a wet reflective street, neon and streetlight mirrored in the puddles, cool blue grade with a warm amber accent, shallow focus, quiet mood.

prompts.zh: 同一位角色的海邊假期：亞麻襯衫或泳裝外搭罩衫，赤腳走在退潮的沙灘上，正午偏晚的強烈陽光，飽和的藍與米白，海風吹起衣角與髮絲，明亮開朗。
prompts.en: The same character on a beach holiday: a linen shirt or swimsuit with a cover-up, walking barefoot on wet sand at low tide, strong late-midday sun, saturated blue and cream, wind lifting the fabric and hair, bright and buoyant.

prompts.zh: 同一位角色在咖啡廳：針織上衣配牛仔褲，低頭翻著書，桌上有咖啡與筆記本，窗光從側面照亮臉部輪廓，暖木色調，背景客人虛化，安靜專注。
prompts.en: The same character in a cafe: a knit top and jeans, head lowered over a book, coffee and a notebook on the table, window light grazing the profile, warm wood tones, other patrons blurred, quiet and absorbed.

prompts.zh: 同一位角色在台灣夜市：簡單的短T與外套，手裡拿著小吃邊走邊笑，兩側攤位燈光斑斕，背景人潮虛化成暖色光斑，高 ISO 顆粒，熱鬧生動的生活感。
prompts.en: The same character at a Taiwanese night market: a simple tee and jacket, holding street food and laughing mid-stride, stall lights glowing on both sides, the crowd blurred into warm bokeh, high-ISO grain, lively and alive.

prompts.zh: 同一位角色在山上：防風外套與登山背包，站在稜線上回頭看鏡頭，身後是雲海與層疊山巒，清晨冷冽的光線，冷藍與暖橘交界，全身廣角構圖。
prompts.en: The same character hiking: a shell jacket and backpack, pausing on a ridge to look back at the camera, a sea of clouds and layered peaks behind, crisp early light where cool meets warm, full-body wide-angle framing.

prompts.zh: 同一位角色穿著 {{服飾}}：衣料紋樣與配件細節清晰，站在相應的傳統建築或庭園前，柔和的自然光，飽和適中的色調，端正的站姿，尊重而不誇張的呈現。
prompts.en: The same character wearing {{costume}}: fabric patterns and accessories rendered in detail, standing before a matching traditional building or garden, soft natural light, moderately saturated palette, upright posture, respectful and unexaggerated.

prompts.zh: 同一位角色的九宮格表情組：開心、大笑、生氣、驚訝、難過、害羞、疑惑、得意、疲倦，九格構圖一致、燈光與背景完全相同，只有表情不同，白色背景。
prompts.en: A 3x3 expression set of the same character: happy, laughing, angry, surprised, sad, shy, puzzled, smug, tired, identical framing, lighting and background across all nine, only the expression changes, white background.

prompts.zh: 同一位角色的多角度組圖：正面、四分之三側、正側面、背面，四張並排，姿勢站姿與服裝完全一致，燈光與背景相同，僅視角改變，白色背景，適合建立角色參考。
prompts.en: Multi-angle set of the same character: front, three-quarter, profile and back, four views in a row, identical pose, wardrobe, lighting and background, only the viewpoint changes, white background, for building a character reference.

prompts.zh: 同一位角色的不同年齡：童年、青年、中年、老年四個階段並排，五官結構與標誌性特徵一致可辨識為同一人，服裝與髮型隨年齡自然變化，相同的燈光與構圖。
prompts.en: The same character at four ages: childhood, youth, middle age and old age side by side, bone structure and signature features consistent so it reads as one person, wardrobe and hair changing naturally with age, identical lighting and framing.

prompts.zh: 同一位角色的四季造型：春裝、夏裝、秋裝、冬裝四張並排，每張的場景色調對應季節，人物姿勢與構圖完全一致，可作為系列圖使用。
prompts.en: The same character across four seasons: spring, summer, autumn and winter outfits side by side, each scene graded to its season, pose and framing identical across all four, designed as a series.

prompts.zh: 同一位角色扮成 {{職業}}：完整的職業服裝與代表性道具，站在相應的工作場景中，該職業典型的光線氛圍，半身構圖，神情符合角色設定。
prompts.en: The same character dressed as a {{profession}}: complete uniform and signature props, standing in the matching workplace, lighting typical of that setting, half-body framing, expression suited to the role.

prompts.zh: 同一位角色與另一位角色的合照：兩人的長相都必須與各自的參考一致，並肩站立身體微微朝內，柔和的側光，中性背景，服裝色系協調，自然放鬆的互動。
prompts.en: A photo of the same character together with a second character: both faces must match their respective references, standing shoulder to shoulder angled inward, soft side light, neutral background, coordinated wardrobe, natural relaxed interaction.

prompts.zh: 同一位角色的頭像：僅頭肩入鏡置中，柔和均勻的正面打光，純色背景，直視鏡頭的自然微笑，1:1 正方形構圖，適合作為社群大頭貼。
prompts.en: Avatar of the same character: head and shoulders centered, soft even frontal light, solid color background, looking into the lens with a natural smile, 1:1 square, made for a social profile picture.

prompts.zh: 同一位角色的連續動作分解圖：{{動作}} 的四個階段並排，人物外貌完全一致，燈光與背景相同，僅姿勢改變，側面視角，白色背景，適合作為動畫參考。
prompts.en: Action breakdown of the same character: four stages of {{action}} in a row, appearance identical throughout, same lighting and background, only the pose changes, side view, white background, suitable as animation reference.

prompts.zh: LINE 貼圖主角設定：一個 {{角色}}，二頭身圓潤造型，大眼睛與簡化的五官，粗黑描邊約 6 像素，飽和平塗的四色配色，無漸層，透明背景，正面站立，縮到 100 像素仍清楚可辨識。
prompts.en: Messaging sticker mascot: a {{character}} with two-head-tall rounded proportions, big eyes and simplified features, bold black outline about 6 pixels, saturated flat four-color palette, no gradients, transparent background, standing front view, still legible at 100 pixels.

prompts.zh: LINE 貼圖組：同一角色做出四種日常問候動作——揮手打招呼、雙手合十拜託、比讚、鞠躬道謝，每格角色旁有粗體手寫感中文字「{{文字}}」，透明背景，風格與線條粗細完全一致。
prompts.en: Sticker set: the same character in four everyday greetings — waving hello, hands pressed in a please, thumbs up, and bowing in thanks, each with bold handwritten-style Chinese text "{{text}}" beside it, transparent background, consistent style and line weight across all four.

prompts.zh: LINE 貼圖：角色以誇張的疲憊表情趴在筆電上，頭上冒出旋轉的星星，旁邊有粗體中文字「加班中」，配色以灰藍與螢光黃對比，粗黑描邊，透明背景，一眼看懂的職場共鳴梗。
prompts.en: Sticker: the character slumped over a laptop with an exaggerated exhausted face, spinning stars above the head, bold Chinese text for overtime beside it, grey-blue against fluorescent yellow, bold black outline, transparent background, instantly readable workplace humor.

prompts.zh: LINE 貼圖：角色盯著手機、眼神死的表情，手機上有明顯的已讀標記，頭上有一滴大汗，旁邊粗體中文字「{{文字}}」，飽和的對比配色，誇張的情緒表現，透明背景。
prompts.en: Sticker: the character staring at a phone with a deadpan expression, a visible read receipt on the screen, one large sweat drop above the head, bold Chinese text "{{text}}" beside it, saturated contrasting palette, exaggerated emotion, transparent background.

prompts.zh: LINE 貼圖：角色情緒爆發的誇張表現——{{情緒}}，臉部變形放大、線條放射、背景有速度線與符號（怒氣井字、淚水噴發、愛心冒出），粗黑描邊，高飽和撞色，透明背景，戲劇性十足。
prompts.en: Sticker: the character in an over-the-top emotional outburst — {{emotion}}, face distorted and enlarged, radiating lines, speed lines and symbols in the background such as anger marks, gushing tears or floating hearts, bold black outline, clashing saturated colors, transparent background, highly theatrical.

prompts.zh: LINE 貼圖：角色穿著 {{節慶}} 主題的裝扮並做出應景動作，周圍有該節慶的小道具點綴，旁邊粗體中文祝賀字「{{文字}}」，喜氣飽和的配色，透明背景，小尺寸仍清楚。
prompts.en: Sticker: the character in {{festival}} costume performing a seasonal gesture, small themed props scattered around, bold Chinese greeting text "{{text}}" beside it, festive saturated palette, transparent background, legible at small size.

prompts.zh: 長輩風格問候貼圖：明亮飽和的花卉與陽光背景，中央是可愛的角色雙手合十或揮手，上方以粗體圓體中文大字寫著「{{文字}}」，字體加白色描邊確保清楚，暖色調，親切熱情。
prompts.en: Elder-style greeting sticker: bright saturated flowers and sunshine background, a cute character with hands pressed together or waving at center, bold rounded Chinese text "{{text}}" across the top with a white outline for legibility, warm palette, friendly and hearty.

prompts.zh: LINE 貼圖：把 {{食物}} 擬人化成有手腳與表情的角色，做出可愛的動作，保留食物本身的辨識特徵，粗黑描邊與飽和平塗，透明背景，旁邊可放短句文字，療癒討喜。
prompts.en: Sticker: {{food}} anthropomorphized with limbs and a face, doing something endearing, keeping the food’s recognizable features, bold outline and saturated flat color, transparent background, room for a short phrase beside it, warm and likeable.

prompts.zh: LINE 貼圖：一隻穿著襯衫與識別證的 {{動物}}，二頭身造型，做出上班族的日常動作（喝咖啡、打電話、崩潰），粗黑描邊，柔和飽和的配色，透明背景，幽默不做作。
prompts.en: Sticker: a {{animal}} in a shirt and lanyard, two-head-tall proportions, performing everyday office actions such as drinking coffee, taking a call or breaking down, bold outline, softly saturated palette, transparent background, funny without trying too hard.

prompts.zh: 純文字貼圖：畫面中只有粗體中文大字「{{文字}}」，字體為圓潤的手寫感黑體，加上粗白描邊與彩色陰影確保在任何聊天背景上都清楚，周圍有少量放射線與星點點綴，透明背景。
prompts.en: Text-only sticker: just the bold Chinese phrase "{{text}}", set in a rounded handwritten-feel sans-serif with a thick white outline and colored drop shadow so it reads on any chat background, a few radiating lines and star accents around it, transparent background.

prompts.zh: 貼圖商店主圖：角色的招牌姿勢置中，背景為單一淺色或簡單圖案，四周留出約 10% 的安全邊距避免被裁切，色彩飽和吸睛，構圖簡潔，縮成小圖仍能一眼認出角色。
prompts.en: Sticker shop main image: the character in its signature pose centered, a single light color or simple pattern behind, roughly 10 percent safe margin on all sides to survive cropping, saturated and eye-catching, simple composition, recognizable when scaled down.

prompts.zh: 手繪簡筆貼圖：用不平整的鉛筆或原子筆線條畫出角色做 {{動作}}，刻意的歪斜與塗改痕跡，僅用一到兩個顏色隨性填色且溢出邊界，透明背景，樸拙隨性的手感。
prompts.en: Hand-drawn doodle sticker: the character {{action}} rendered in uneven pencil or ballpoint line, deliberately wobbly with visible corrections, one or two colors filled loosely past the lines, transparent background, artless and charming.

prompts.zh: 網拍商品主圖：{{商品}}置中占畫面約七成，純白或極淺灰背景，均勻無影打光讓顏色完全準確，商品邊緣銳利，右上角留出乾淨區域可加賣點文字，1:1 正方形，符合購物平台上架規範。
prompts.en: Marketplace listing main image: {{product}} centered filling about 70 percent of the frame, pure white or very light grey background, even shadowless lighting for exact color, crisp product edges, a clean area at upper right for a selling-point label, 1:1 square, compliant with marketplace listing rules.

prompts.zh: 網拍服飾實穿照：模特兒穿著 {{商品}}站立全身入鏡，自然的站姿與微側身展現版型，淺灰或米白背景，柔和均勻的打光確保布料顏色準確，衣物皺褶與材質清楚，直式 3:4。
prompts.en: Apparel on-model shot: the model wearing {{product}} in full body, natural stance angled slightly to show the cut, light grey or off-white background, soft even lighting for accurate fabric color, drape and texture clearly visible, 3:4 portrait.

prompts.zh: 網拍細節圖：極近距離拍攝 {{商品}}的關鍵細節——縫線、拉鍊、鈕扣、材質紋理或商標，斜射光強調凹凸，淺景深讓周邊柔化，色彩還原準確，讓買家看清質感的關鍵輔圖。
prompts.en: Marketplace detail shot: an extreme close-up of a key feature of {{product}} such as stitching, zipper, buttons, material grain or logo, raking light emphasizing relief, shallow focus softening the surroundings, accurate color, the shot that proves the quality.

prompts.zh: 網拍尺寸對照圖：{{商品}}平放在淺色背景上，旁邊放一隻手或一枚硬幣作為比例參考，兩者在同一平面對焦一致，正俯視 90 度，均勻打光，清楚傳達真實大小，減少退貨的關鍵圖。
prompts.en: Marketplace scale image: {{product}} laid flat on a light background beside a hand or coin for reference, both on one plane and equally sharp, straight 90-degree overhead, even lighting, communicating true size clearly to reduce returns.

prompts.zh: 網拍情境圖：{{商品}}被自然地使用在真實生活場景中，有人的手或身影參與其中，環境道具支撐使用想像，柔和的自然光，暖色調，讓買家看見「用起來的樣子」。
prompts.en: Marketplace lifestyle image: {{product}} being used naturally in a real setting, a hand or figure involved, surrounding props supporting the use case, soft natural light, warm palette, showing the buyer what it looks like in their life.

prompts.zh: 網拍多色一覽圖：同一款 {{商品}}的所有顏色整齊並排或扇形展開，間距一致、角度一致，純白背景，均勻打光確保每個顏色都準確可辨，正俯視或正面平視，一目了然。
prompts.en: Marketplace colorway lineup: every color of the same {{product}} arranged in an even row or fan, identical spacing and angle, pure white background, even lighting so each shade reads accurately, top-down or straight-on, instantly scannable.

prompts.zh: 網拍組合圖：{{商品}}與所有附贈配件在淺色背景上整齊排列成網格，每項物件間距均勻、大小關係真實，均勻無影光，正俯視 90 度，清楚呈現「買到什麼」，適合作為規格說明圖。
prompts.en: Marketplace bundle shot: {{product}} with every included accessory arranged in an even grid on a light background, consistent spacing and true relative scale, even shadowless light, 90-degree overhead, clearly answering what the buyer receives.

prompts.zh: 賣場首頁橫幅：左側為 {{商品}} 的去背主體，右側留出大片乾淨區域放標題與折扣文字，柔和的漸層背景搭配品牌主色，輕微的幾何裝飾不搶焦點，橫式寬幅構圖，縮小後文字區仍清楚。
prompts.en: Storefront banner: the cut-out {{product}} on the left, a large clean field on the right for a headline and discount copy, soft gradient background in the brand color, restrained geometric accents, wide horizontal format, the text area still readable when scaled down.

prompts.zh: 限時促銷圖：{{商品}}置中，背景為放射狀撞色與爆炸框，四周有飄落的碎紙與價格標籤造型，高飽和的紅黃配色，中央下方留出區塊放「{{文字}}」，搶眼但商品仍清楚可辨。
prompts.en: Flash-sale graphic: {{product}} centered against a radial burst in clashing colors with a starburst frame, falling confetti and price-tag shapes around, saturated red and yellow, a block below center for "{{text}}", loud yet keeping the product clear.

prompts.zh: 素人開箱風格照：{{商品}}半開的包裝盒放在木桌或床單上，旁邊有手機與隨手擺放的日常物件，自然的室內光線略帶不完美，手機拍攝般的真實感，不做棚拍造型，可信度高的評價用圖。
prompts.en: Unboxing-style photo: the half-opened package of {{product}} on a wooden table or bedsheet, a phone and everyday clutter beside it, natural indoor light with mild imperfection, the honest look of a phone snapshot rather than a studio shot, credible review imagery.

prompts.zh: 直播預告圖：畫面右側是主播的半身剪影或去背人像，左側大片區域放「{{文字}}」與時間，背景為活潑的漸層與光斑，明亮高對比配色，直式 9:16 適合限時動態，一眼看到時間與主題。
prompts.en: Livestream announcement graphic: the host cut out or silhouetted on the right, a large field on the left for "{{text}}" and the start time, lively gradient and bokeh background, bright high-contrast palette, 9:16 vertical for stories, time and topic immediately visible.

prompts.zh: A/B 主圖對照：同一件 {{商品}}以兩種不同呈現方式並列——左為純白去背棚拍、右為生活情境照，兩者商品大小與角度接近以便公平比較，說明用途的對照圖。
prompts.en: A/B listing image comparison: the same {{product}} presented two ways side by side — a pure white studio cut-out on the left and a lifestyle context shot on the right, product scale and angle matched for a fair comparison.

prompts.zh: 美式漫畫風格：粗細變化強烈的墨線輪廓、班戴網點的半色調陰影、飽和的原色平塗、戲劇性的仰角構圖與動態線條，背景有放射狀速度線，角落有對話框與狀聲字。主題為 {{主體}}。
prompts.en: American comic book style: bold varying ink outlines, Ben-Day dot halftone shading, saturated flat primary colors, dramatic low-angle composition and dynamic action lines, radial speed lines in the background, speech balloon and sound effect in a corner. Subject: {{subject}}.

prompts.zh: 1960 年代美漫封面風格：粗獷的墨線與明顯的印刷網點、套版輕微偏移的色偏、泛黃的粗紙質地、頂部有粗體標題橫幅與價格標，強烈的戲劇性構圖與誇張表情。主題為 {{主體}}。
prompts.en: 1960s comic cover style: rugged ink linework with visible halftone dots, slight color registration offset, yellowed pulp paper texture, a bold title banner and price tag along the top, high-drama composition and exaggerated expressions. Subject: {{subject}}.

prompts.zh: 韓國網漫風格：乾淨的細線稿、柔和的漸層上色、通透明亮的膚色與大量光暈、簡化但精緻的背景、直式長條構圖，人物比例修長，情緒細膩的表情。主題為 {{主體}}。
prompts.en: Korean webtoon style: clean fine linework, soft gradient coloring, luminous skin with generous glow, simplified yet refined backgrounds, tall vertical composition, elongated proportions, nuanced emotional expression. Subject: {{subject}}.

prompts.zh: 3D 動畫電影風格：圓潤誇張的角色比例、大眼睛與柔和的次表面散射皮膚、細膩的毛髮與布料模擬、電影級的三點打光與景深、溫暖飽和的色彩，親切討喜的表情。主題為 {{主體}}。
prompts.en: 3D animated feature style: rounded exaggerated proportions, large eyes and soft subsurface-scattering skin, detailed hair and cloth simulation, cinematic three-point lighting and depth of field, warm saturated color, appealing friendly expression. Subject: {{subject}}.

prompts.zh: 塑膠積木玩具風格：所有元素都由方形積木塊組成，可見圓形凸點與模具接縫，光滑的塑膠反光，微縮攝影的淺景深，明亮的原色配色，柔和的棚拍打光。場景為 {{場景}}。
prompts.en: Plastic brick toy style: everything built from rectangular blocks with visible studs and mold seams, glossy plastic highlights, macro miniature depth of field, bright primary palette, soft studio lighting. Scene: {{scene}}.

prompts.zh: Y2K 千禧美學：液態金屬與全息彩虹反光、氣泡感的圓潤字體、亮粉紫與電光藍配色、星形閃光與蝴蝶元素、輕微的膠片模糊與光暈，混亂中帶著懷舊的未來感。主題為 {{主體}}。
prompts.en: Y2K millennium aesthetic: liquid chrome and holographic iridescence, bubbly rounded typography, hot pink-purple and electric blue, star sparkles and butterfly motifs, slight film blur and bloom, a nostalgic future rendered in chaos. Subject: {{subject}}.

prompts.zh: 故障藝術風格：RGB 色差偏移、水平掃描線與訊號斷裂、像素破碎與重複位移的區塊、螢光洋紅與青的色偏、黑色底，數位訊號崩壞的視覺語彙。主題為 {{主體}}。
prompts.en: Glitch art style: RGB channel offset, horizontal scanlines and signal tearing, shattered pixel blocks displaced in bands, fluorescent magenta and cyan casts, black ground, the visual language of a corrupted signal. Subject: {{subject}}.

prompts.zh: 孔版印刷風格：兩到三色專色套印、明顯的網點與輕微的套版偏移、油墨的不均勻與輕微暈開、螢光粉與藍的專色、粗糙的再生紙質地，質樸的獨立出版感。主題為 {{主體}}。
prompts.en: Risograph print style: two or three spot-color layers, visible dot screens and slight registration offset, uneven ink coverage with light smudging, fluorescent pink and blue inks, coarse recycled paper texture, the feel of independent publishing. Subject: {{subject}}.

prompts.zh: 新中式國潮風格：傳統紋樣以現代扁平手法重構、朱紅與靛藍搭配燙金線條、幾何化的雲紋與山水、粗體的現代中文字排版、留白克制，古典元素與當代設計語言並置。主題為 {{主體}}。
prompts.en: Contemporary Chinese-revival style: traditional motifs reconstructed in a modern flat idiom, vermilion and indigo with gold linework, geometricized clouds and landscape, bold modern Chinese typography, disciplined negative space, classical elements set against contemporary design language. Subject: {{subject}}.

prompts.zh: 浮世繪木版畫風格：清晰的墨線輪廓、平塗的色塊與漸層暈染、藍色為主的傳統配色、程式化的雲與波浪、和紙的纖維質地與輕微的木紋壓痕，右上角有題款方框。主題為 {{主體}}。
prompts.en: Ukiyo-e woodblock style: crisp ink outlines, flat color fields with gradated bokashi, an indigo-led traditional palette, stylized clouds and waves, washi fiber texture with faint woodgrain impression, an inscription cartouche at upper right. Subject: {{subject}}.

prompts.zh: 暗黑學院美學：深墨綠與棕的沉鬱配色、古老圖書館與皮革書冊、燭光與窗光交錯的低調光線、羊毛格紋與斜紋領帶、霧氣與塵埃、輕微褪色的底片質感，靜謐而神秘。主題為 {{主體}}。
prompts.en: Dark academia aesthetic: brooding deep green and brown palette, old library and leather-bound books, low-key mix of candlelight and window light, wool tweed and striped ties, mist and dust, gently faded film tones, hushed and enigmatic. Subject: {{subject}}.

prompts.zh: 田園慢活美學：亞麻與棉質織品、野花與手工陶器、蜂蜜色的柔和自然光、褪色的粉綠與奶油配色、輕微的柔焦與光暈、鄉間廚房或草地場景，溫柔而懷舊的生活感。主題為 {{主體}}。
prompts.en: Cottagecore aesthetic: linen and cotton textiles, wildflowers and handmade pottery, honeyed soft natural light, faded sage and cream palette, gentle diffusion and bloom, a country kitchen or meadow setting, tender and nostalgic. Subject: {{subject}}.

prompts.zh: 液態金屬渲染風格：高反射的鏡面鉻金屬表面流動變形，環境反射清晰可見，柔和的攝影棚 HDRI 打光，深色漸層背景，一抹彩虹色的邊緣折射，極簡構圖，未來感十足。主題為 {{主體}}。
prompts.en: Liquid chrome render style: highly reflective mirror-chrome surfaces flowing and deforming, environment reflections clearly readable, soft studio HDRI lighting, dark gradient background, a hint of iridescent edge refraction, minimal composition, distinctly futuristic. Subject: {{subject}}.

prompts.zh: 嚴格對稱的電影構圖：主體置中、消失點正中央、左右元素完美鏡像，粉彩與芥黃的復古配色，平面化的正面視角，戲劇性的色彩分區，人物表情克制平淡，工整而略帶荒謬的美感。場景為 {{場景}}。
prompts.en: Rigorously symmetrical cinematic composition: subject dead center, vanishing point centered, left and right elements mirrored, pastel and mustard retro palette, flattened frontal view, dramatic color blocking, deliberately deadpan expressions, meticulous and gently absurd. Scene: {{scene}}.

prompts.zh: 黑色電影風格：強烈的明暗對比、百葉窗投射在牆與臉上的條紋陰影、雨夜街燈與煙霧、低角度與傾斜的構圖、黑白高反差帶顆粒、風衣與軟呢帽，懸疑而壓抑的氛圍。主題為 {{主體}}。
prompts.en: Film noir style: extreme chiaroscuro, venetian blind stripes falling across wall and face, rain-slicked street lamps and cigarette smoke, low and canted angles, high-contrast grainy black and white, trench coat and fedora, tense and claustrophobic. Subject: {{subject}}.

prompts.zh: 超現實剪貼拼貼風格：不同來源的印刷圖像被剪下重組，可見粗糙的剪裁邊緣與紙張陰影，比例被刻意錯置，黑白照片與飽和色塊混用，米黃紙背景，荒謬而詩意的並置。主題為 {{主體}}。
prompts.en: Surrealist cut-paper collage: printed images from different sources cropped and recombined, rough scissor edges and paper drop shadows visible, scale deliberately mismatched, black-and-white photography mixed with saturated color fields, cream paper ground, absurd and poetic juxtaposition. Subject: {{subject}}.

prompts.zh: Bento 便當盒版面設計：畫面切分為大小不一的圓角矩形區塊如便當格，每格放置一個主題元素或資料，深色底搭配一到兩個強調色，統一的圓角半徑與間距，現代科技產品發表視覺。主題為 {{主題}}。
prompts.en: Bento box layout design: the frame divided into rounded rectangles of varying sizes like a bento tray, each cell holding one element or data point, dark ground with one or two accent colors, uniform corner radius and gutters, modern tech-launch visual language. Subject: {{theme}}.

prompts.zh: 極簡奢華風格：單一主體置於大量負空間中，米白與炭黑的極簡配色搭配一點金屬色，柔和的大面積側光與乾淨的長影，材質質感細膩（絲絨、石材、霧面金屬），構圖克制，安靜的高級感。主題為 {{主體}}。
prompts.en: Quiet-luxury minimalism: a single subject in expansive negative space, a cream and charcoal palette with one metallic accent, broad soft side light and a clean long shadow, refined materials such as velvet, stone and brushed metal, disciplined composition, understated premium feel. Subject: {{subject}}.

prompts.zh: 霓虹燈管風格：主體以發光的霓虹管線條勾勒輪廓，洋紅與青的雙色光管，黑色或深色磚牆背景，光線在牆面與地面產生柔和的暈染與反射，輕微的光暈與色差，夜店招牌質感。主題為 {{主體}}。
prompts.en: Neon tube style: the subject outlined in glowing neon tubing, magenta and cyan two-color light, black or dark brick background, the glow bleeding softly onto wall and floor, slight bloom and chromatic fringing, the look of a bar sign. Subject: {{subject}}.

prompts.zh: 針織毛線質感風格：整個畫面由粗棒針織紋構成，可見清晰的針目與毛線纖維，柔軟的立體起伏與陰影，溫暖的米色與燕麥色系，柔和的側光帶出織紋，療癒的手作觸感。主題為 {{主體}}。
prompts.en: Chunky knit texture style: the entire image rendered as hand-knitted stitches, individual loops and wool fibers clearly visible, soft dimensional relief and shadow, warm oatmeal and cream palette, gentle side light bringing out the weave, comforting and tactile. Subject: {{subject}}.

prompts.zh: 把照片中的主體完整去背，換成純白色無縫背景。主體的邊緣要乾淨銳利，髮絲與細節不可缺損，原本的光線方向與陰影保持自然，主體本身的顏色與細節完全不變。
prompts.en: Cut out the subject from the photo and place it on a pure white seamless background. Keep the edges clean and sharp with no loss of hair strands or fine detail, preserve the original lighting direction and a natural contact shadow, and leave the subject’s color and detail completely unchanged.

prompts.zh: 保留照片中的人物或主體完全不變，只把背景換成 {{新背景}}。新背景的光線方向、色溫與明暗必須與主體原本的打光一致，邊緣過渡自然無合成痕跡，景深也要與主體的焦段相符。
prompts.en: Keep the subject in the photo entirely unchanged and replace only the background with {{new background}}. The new background’s light direction, color temperature and brightness must match the subject’s existing lighting, edges must blend without any visible compositing seam, and the depth of field should match the subject’s focal length.

prompts.zh: 修復這張老照片：去除刮痕、摺痕、霉斑與污漬，補上缺角與破損處，還原褪色的對比與細節，臉部五官必須保持原本的樣子不可重畫，維持底片原有的顆粒質感，不要過度平滑。
prompts.en: Restore this old photograph: remove scratches, creases, mold spots and stains, reconstruct torn corners and missing areas, recover faded contrast and detail. The facial features must stay exactly as they are and must not be redrawn. Keep the original film grain and avoid over-smoothing.

prompts.zh: 為這張黑白照片自然上色。膚色要真實符合人種與年齡，衣物與環境的顏色要符合該年代的常見材質與染料，色彩飽和度克制不誇張，不改變任何構圖與人物長相，成果要像當年就用彩色底片拍的。
prompts.en: Colorize this black and white photograph naturally. Skin tones must be realistic for the subject’s age and ethnicity, clothing and surroundings should use colors plausible for the era’s materials and dyes, saturation restrained rather than vivid. Do not alter the composition or the subjects’ features — the result should look as if it had been shot on color film at the time.

prompts.zh: 人像精修：去除暫時性的痘痘與雜點，保留毛孔與皮膚紋理不可磨成塑膠感，修飾髮絲雜毛與衣物皺褶，輕微提亮眼神光，膚色調整為自然健康，五官結構與臉型完全不可更動。
prompts.en: Portrait retouching: remove temporary blemishes and stray spots while keeping pores and skin texture intact — no plastic smoothing. Tidy flyaway hairs and clothing wrinkles, slightly brighten the catchlights, adjust skin tone to look naturally healthy. Do not alter the facial structure or proportions in any way.

prompts.zh: 移除照片中的 {{移除對象}}，並用符合周圍紋理、透視與光線的內容自然填補該區域，不可留下模糊塊或重複的圖樣，畫面其餘部分完全保持原樣。
prompts.en: Remove {{target}} from the photo and fill the area with content that matches the surrounding texture, perspective and lighting. Do not leave blurred patches or repeated patterns, and keep the rest of the image completely unchanged.

prompts.zh: 把照片中的天空換成 {{天空}}，地面與建築物完全保留。新天空的光線方向必須與原本畫面的陰影方向一致，並讓地面的色溫與亮度隨新天空自然調整，地平線邊緣乾淨無白邊。
prompts.en: Replace the sky in this photo with {{sky}}, keeping the ground and buildings entirely intact. The new sky’s light direction must match the existing shadows, the ground’s color temperature and brightness should adapt naturally to it, and the horizon edge must be clean with no halo.

prompts.zh: 重新打光：保留原本的構圖與人物不變，把平淡的光線改成 {{光線}}，明暗層次要合理，陰影方向一致，高光不過曝、暗部保留細節，整體看起來像現場就是這樣打光的。
prompts.en: Relight the image: keep the composition and subject unchanged, and replace the flat lighting with {{lighting}}. Tonal transitions must be plausible, shadow directions consistent, highlights unclipped and shadows retaining detail — the result should look as if it were lit that way on set.

prompts.zh: 把這張低解析度的照片放大並還原細節：補回自然的紋理與邊緣銳度，去除壓縮產生的方塊雜訊與色斑，不可產生原本不存在的細節或改變人物長相，成果要自然不假。
prompts.en: Upscale this low-resolution photo and recover detail: restore natural texture and edge sharpness, remove compression blocking and color artifacts. Do not invent detail that was not there or alter the subject’s features — the result must look natural, not synthetic.

prompts.zh: 把這張生活照轉成標準證件照：去背換純白底，裁切為頭肩構圖並讓頭部佔畫面適當比例，補上均勻的正面柔光消除臉上陰影，服裝改為深色素面上衣，五官與髮型完全保持原樣。
prompts.en: Convert this casual photo into a standard ID portrait: cut out and place on a pure white background, crop to head and shoulders with the head at an appropriate proportion of the frame, add even frontal soft light to remove facial shadows, and change the clothing to a plain dark top. Keep the facial features and hairstyle exactly as they are.

prompts.zh: 清理這張商品照：去除背景雜物與反光污漬，把背景換成純白，校正商品的透視讓垂直線筆直，還原真實色彩，保留材質紋理與商標文字清晰可讀，加上淡淡的接地陰影。
prompts.en: Clean up this product photo: remove background clutter and stray reflections, replace the background with pure white, correct the perspective so vertical lines are straight, restore true color, keep material texture and label text crisply legible, and add a faint contact shadow.

prompts.zh: 把這張照片的畫面向 {{方向}} 延伸擴展，新增區域的透視、光線、色調與質感必須與原圖完全銜接，看不出接縫，延伸出來的內容要符合原場景的合理延續，不可出現重複的圖樣。
prompts.en: Extend this photo outward toward the {{direction}}. The new area’s perspective, lighting, color and texture must match the original seamlessly with no visible join, and the added content must be a plausible continuation of the scene without repeated patterns.

prompts.zh: 遊戲卡牌插畫：{{主體}} 佔據畫面中央，戲劇性的仰角與放射狀構圖，濃烈的光影對比與飄浮的能量粒子，背景簡化為漸層與抽象元素避免搶焦點，上方與下方預留卡框與文字空間，直式 5:7 構圖。
prompts.en: Trading card illustration: {{subject}} dominating the center, dramatic low angle and radial composition, intense chiaroscuro with drifting energy particles, background simplified to gradients and abstract shapes so it never competes, space reserved at top and bottom for the frame and text, 5:7 portrait.

prompts.zh: 遊戲道具圖示：{{道具}} 以四分之三角度懸浮於透明背景上，柔和的頂光加冷色邊緣光，材質質感清晰（金屬反光、皮革紋理、寶石折射），輕微的發光外框，統一的光源方向以便成組使用。
prompts.en: Game item icon: {{item}} floating at a three-quarter angle on a transparent background, soft top light with a cool rim, material qualities clearly read — metallic reflection, leather grain, gem refraction — a faint glow outline, consistent light direction so it works as part of a set.

prompts.zh: 技能圖示組：六個圓形圖示並排，各代表 {{主題}} 的不同能力，統一的圓框樣式與內縮邊距，每個以一種主色區分並帶柔和內發光，簡化的符號造型，深色底，成套使用時視覺一致。
prompts.en: Skill icon set: six circular icons in a row representing different abilities of {{theme}}, uniform ring frame and inner padding, each keyed to one accent color with a soft inner glow, simplified symbolic forms, dark ground, visually consistent as a set.

prompts.zh: 遊戲場景概念稿：{{場景}} 的廣角全景，大氣透視讓遠景逐層變淡，強烈的方向性光源穿過空間製造光柱，前景有剪影元素建立層次，筆觸鬆放不追求細節，重氣氛勝於精確。
prompts.en: Game environment concept art: a wide vista of {{scene}}, atmospheric perspective fading the distance in layers, strong directional light shafting through the space, silhouetted foreground elements establishing depth, loose brushwork over precision, mood before accuracy.

prompts.zh: 遊戲角色立繪：全身直立，四分之三角度，服裝與配件細節完整，柔和的雙側打光讓輪廓清晰，腳下有簡單的接地陰影，透明或純色背景，構圖適合疊在對話介面上。
prompts.en: Game character standing art: full body upright at a three-quarter angle, costume and accessories fully detailed, soft two-sided lighting keeping the silhouette clean, a simple contact shadow at the feet, transparent or flat background, composed to sit over a dialogue interface.

prompts.zh: 像素藝術場景：{{場景}} 以 32 位元色階繪製，清晰的方格像素與有限調色盤，等距或側視角，抖色處理的漸層，簡潔的物件輪廓，復古遊戲畫面的親切感。
prompts.en: Pixel art scene: {{scene}} rendered in a 32-bit palette, crisp square pixels and a limited color set, isometric or side view, dithered gradients, clean object silhouettes, the warmth of a retro game screen.

prompts.zh: 遊戲介面框設計：{{風格}} 主題的對話框、按鈕與血條，統一的邊框裝飾與圓角，適度的立體浮雕與內陰影，中央留空供文字，透明背景，各元件並排展示。
prompts.en: Game UI kit: dialogue box, buttons and health bar in a {{style}} theme, matching border ornament and corner radius, restrained bevel and inner shadow, centers left empty for text, transparent background, components laid out side by side.

prompts.zh: 怪物角色設計：以 {{原型}} 為基礎的奇幻生物，解剖結構合理可信，材質層次分明（鱗片、甲殼、皮毛），威嚇的姿態與清晰的輪廓，中性背景與比例參考人形，概念設計稿質感。
prompts.en: Monster design: a fantasy creature based on {{base}}, anatomy plausible and readable, layered materials such as scales, chitin and fur, a threatening pose with a strong silhouette, neutral background with a human figure for scale, concept-design quality.

prompts.zh: 遊戲地圖俯視圖：{{區域}} 的手繪風格地圖，地形以簡化的圖示表現（山脈、森林、聚落），羊皮紙質地與手寫地名標註，柔和的做舊邊緣，指北針與比例尺在角落，冒險感十足。
prompts.en: Game map from above: a hand-drawn map of {{region}}, terrain shown with simplified icons for mountains, forest and settlements, parchment texture with hand-lettered place names, softly aged edges, compass rose and scale bar in the corners, full of adventure.

prompts.zh: 成就徽章設計：圓形或盾形金屬徽章，中央是 {{主題}} 的簡化符號，邊緣有齒紋或桂冠裝飾，金銀銅三階配色，柔和的金屬反光與立體浮雕，透明背景，成組時風格一致。
prompts.en: Achievement badge: a circular or shield-shaped metal badge, a simplified {{theme}} symbol at center, notched or laurel edging, gold-silver-bronze tiers, soft metallic reflection and relief, transparent background, consistent across the set.

prompts.zh: 專輯封面：歌手的半身人像置於畫面偏下，上方大片留空供專輯名，強烈的單一色光染在臉上，深色背景，輕微的底片顆粒與暗角，情緒濃烈的表情，1:1 正方形。
prompts.en: Album cover: the artist framed from the chest up, placed low in the frame with a large clear field above for the title, a single strong colored light washing the face, dark background, subtle film grain and vignette, an intense expression, 1:1 square.

prompts.zh: 抽象專輯封面：由流動的色彩、幾何切割與失真紋理構成，沒有具體形象，限定三色的大膽配色，粗糙的印刷質感與輕微錯位，中央或角落留出文字空間，實驗性強烈，1:1。
prompts.en: Abstract album cover: built from flowing color, geometric cuts and distorted texture with no literal imagery, a bold three-color palette, coarse print texture with slight misregistration, space reserved at center or corner for type, strongly experimental, 1:1.

prompts.zh: 復古黑膠唱片封面：1970 年代的視覺語彙，褪色的暖色調與粗糙的紙質，中央是一張略微過曝的人像或場景照，粗體的復古字體排版，邊緣有磨損與環形壓痕，懷舊質感，1:1。
prompts.en: Vintage vinyl sleeve: 1970s visual language, faded warm tones on coarse board stock, a slightly overexposed portrait or scene at center, bold period typography, worn edges and a ring impression from the record, nostalgic, 1:1.

prompts.zh: 演唱會主視覺：舞台燈光與雷射光束穿透煙霧，觀眾席的手臂與螢光棒成海，逆光讓表演者只剩剪影，強烈的洋紅與青光對比，長曝的光軌，震撼的現場氛圍，橫式。
prompts.en: Concert key visual: stage lights and laser beams cutting through haze, a sea of raised arms and glowsticks, the performer reduced to a backlit silhouette, strong magenta against cyan, long-exposure light trails, overwhelming live atmosphere, landscape format.

prompts.zh: 樂器靜物特寫：{{樂器}} 在深色背景中被單一側光勾勒，木紋、金屬與弦的質感細膩可見，柔和的反光與深沉的陰影，大量留白，安靜而有重量的質感，適合作為音樂品牌形象。
prompts.en: Instrument still life: {{instrument}} shaped by a single side light against a dark ground, woodgrain, metal and strings rendered in fine detail, soft reflections and deep shadow, generous negative space, quiet and weighty, suited to a music brand.

prompts.zh: 歌詞卡設計：深色背景上以細襯線或手寫字體排出「{{文字}}」，分行有呼吸感，一側有淡淡的抽象紋理或光暈，其餘大量留白，色彩克制只用一個強調色，安靜有情緒，1:1 或 4:5。
prompts.en: Lyric card: "{{text}}" set in a fine serif or handwritten face on a dark ground, line breaks paced to breathe, a faint abstract texture or glow on one side, otherwise generous emptiness, restrained color with a single accent, quiet and emotive, 1:1 or 4:5.

prompts.zh: 人工智慧概念圖：由光線構成的神經網路節點在深色空間中連結，資料流沿著路徑流動並在節點處亮起，冷藍與青綠的漸層光，深邃的景深與體積光，抽象但秩序井然，科技感而非恐怖感。
prompts.en: AI concept visual: neural network nodes built from light connecting across a dark space, data flowing along the paths and igniting at each node, cool blue and teal gradients, deep focus falloff and volumetric light, abstract yet orderly, technological rather than ominous.

prompts.zh: 智慧城市概念圖：現代城市天際線上疊加半透明的資料圖層與連線，交通與能源流動以發光線條表示，藍調時刻的天空，冷色調加一抹琥珀，俯視廣角，秩序與科技並存。
prompts.en: Smart city concept: a modern skyline overlaid with translucent data layers and connection lines, traffic and energy flows drawn as glowing paths, blue-hour sky, cool palette with an amber accent, high wide-angle view, orderly and technological.

prompts.zh: 人機協作概念圖：機械手臂與人的手在中央幾乎接觸，背景是明亮潔淨的實驗空間並虛化，柔和的側光讓金屬與皮膚的質感形成對比，冷白加暖膚色，溫和而非對立的氛圍。
prompts.en: Human-robot collaboration concept: a robotic arm and a human hand nearly touching at center, a bright clean lab space blurred behind, soft side light contrasting metal against skin, cool white with warm flesh tones, cooperative rather than adversarial.

prompts.zh: 資訊安全概念圖：發光的盾形結構由六角網格構成，環繞著流動的資料流與被阻擋的紅色訊號，深藍近黑的背景，冷色主調加警示紅點綴，體積光與粒子，專業可信不誇張。
prompts.en: Cybersecurity concept: a glowing shield formed from a hexagonal mesh, surrounded by flowing data streams and deflected red signals, near-black navy background, cool base palette with warning-red accents, volumetric light and particles, credible rather than sensational.

prompts.zh: 太空探索場景：太空站或探測器懸浮於行星上方，行星大氣層在邊緣形成細緻的光暈，遠處恆星為唯一光源製造強烈明暗，深黑背景與細密星點，寫實的金屬與隔熱材質，壯闊而孤寂。
prompts.en: Space exploration scene: a station or probe suspended above a planet, the atmosphere forming a fine glowing limb, a distant star as the only light source creating extreme contrast, deep black field with dense stars, realistic metal and thermal blanket materials, vast and solitary.

prompts.zh: 綠能永續概念圖：風力發電機與太陽能板座落在起伏的綠色丘陵上，清澈的天空與流動的雲影，明亮飽和的自然色，柔和的清晨光線，開闊的廣角構圖，樂觀而不說教。
prompts.en: Renewable energy concept: wind turbines and solar arrays across rolling green hills, clear sky with drifting cloud shadows, bright saturated natural color, soft early light, open wide-angle composition, optimistic without preaching.

prompts.zh: 微觀科學視覺：發光的粒子與能量場在深色空間中交互作用，波紋與軌跡以細緻的線條表現，冷紫與青的漸層，強烈的體積光與景深，抽象卻有物理感的秩序，科普視覺用途。
prompts.en: Microscopic science visual: glowing particles and energy fields interacting in dark space, waves and trajectories drawn as fine lines, cool violet and cyan gradients, strong volumetric light and depth of field, abstract yet governed by a sense of physics, for science communication.

prompts.zh: 全息未來介面：半透明的資料面板懸浮在空中，細緻的線框、圖表與文字層層排列，操作者的手在其中滑動，冷青色的發光加深色環境，輕微的掃描線與雜訊，科幻但不誇張的實用感。
prompts.en: Holographic future interface: translucent data panels floating in mid-air, layered wireframes, charts and labels, an operator’s hand swiping through them, cool cyan glow against a dark environment, faint scanlines and noise, science-fiction grounded in plausibility.

prompts.zh: 美甲作品特寫：一雙保養良好的手輕放在絨布或大理石上，指甲的 {{款式}} 造型與光澤清晰可見，微距鏡頭捕捉細節與亮片折射，柔和的環形光形成均勻反光，淺色乾淨背景，色彩還原精準。
prompts.en: Nail art close-up: a well-groomed pair of hands resting on velvet or marble, the {{style}} design and gloss clearly readable, macro lens capturing detail and glitter refraction, soft ring light giving an even sheen, clean light background, precise color rendering.

prompts.zh: SPA 療程空間：鋪著白色毛巾的按摩床、燭光與精油瓶、竹編與石材元素，暖黃的間接照明與大量陰影層次，低飽和的米棕色調，安靜放鬆的氛圍，廣角帶出空間的舒適感。
prompts.en: Spa treatment room: a massage table with white towels, candles and essential oil bottles, bamboo and stone elements, warm indirect lighting with layered shadow, muted taupe palette, quiet and restorative, wide angle conveying comfort.

prompts.zh: 健身房空間形象照：整齊排列的器材與橡膠地板，工業感的黑鐵與水泥質地，冷白 LED 加一道強調色燈光，遠處有人正在訓練成為畫面焦點，高對比深色調，專業有力量感。
prompts.en: Gym interior: rows of equipment on rubber flooring, industrial black steel and concrete, cool white LED with one accent color wash, a figure training in the distance as the focal point, high-contrast dark grade, professional and powerful.

prompts.zh: 餐飲店面外觀照：黃昏時分店內暖黃燈光透出，招牌清晰可辨，門口有植栽與立牌，街道上有一點行人動態模糊，藍調時刻的冷藍天空與暖色室內形成對比，正面略帶透視的構圖。
prompts.en: Restaurant storefront at dusk: warm interior light spilling out, signage clearly legible, plants and a sandwich board by the door, a hint of pedestrian motion blur, blue-hour sky contrasting the warm interior, near-frontal view with slight perspective.

prompts.zh: 咖啡廳品牌形象照：吧台上的手沖器具、磨豆機與陶杯排列有序，咖啡師的手正在注水，蒸氣與水流被清晰捕捉，木質與黑鐵材質，暖色側光，淺景深，職人專注的氛圍。
prompts.en: Cafe brand image: pour-over gear, grinder and ceramic cups arranged along the bar, the barista’s hands mid-pour, steam and the water stream crisply caught, wood and black steel materials, warm side light, shallow focus, focused craft atmosphere.

prompts.zh: 補習班教室情境：明亮整潔的教室，白板上有板書，學生的背影在座位上專注聽講，老師站在前方講解，均勻的日光燈與窗光，清爽的藍白色調，積極正向的學習氛圍。
prompts.en: Cram school classroom: a bright tidy room, notes on the whiteboard, students seen from behind attentive at their desks, the teacher explaining at the front, even fluorescent and window light, fresh blue-and-white palette, positive learning atmosphere.

prompts.zh: 寵物美容店場景：美容師正在為 {{品種}}吹整毛髮，寵物表情放鬆配合，工作檯乾淨整齊，柔和明亮的打光讓毛髮蓬鬆質感清晰，暖色調，親切專業不冰冷。
prompts.en: Pet grooming scene: a groomer blow-drying a {{breed}}, the pet relaxed and cooperative, a clean tidy station, soft bright lighting rendering the fluffy coat clearly, warm palette, friendly and professional rather than clinical.

prompts.zh: 汽車美容成果照：剛完成鍍膜的車身在燈光下形成鏡面般的連續反光，水珠在漆面上結成完美的圓珠，深色的施工廠房背景，強烈的邊緣光勾勒車身曲線，專業質感。
prompts.en: Auto detailing result: a freshly coated body panel throwing continuous mirror-like reflections, water beading into perfect spheres on the paint, a dark workshop background, strong rim light tracing the body curves, professional finish.

prompts.zh: 診所診間形象照：明亮潔淨的診間，設備排列整齊，淺木色與白色的溫和配色，充足的自然光與均勻補光，沒有壓迫感的構圖，親切安心而非冰冷的醫療感。
prompts.en: Clinic consultation room: a bright spotless space, equipment neatly arranged, gentle light-wood and white palette, ample daylight with even fill, an unintimidating composition, reassuring rather than clinical.

prompts.zh: 手作工作室場景：工作檯上散置著工具、材料與半成品，職人的雙手正在製作 {{作品}}，側窗光帶出木屑與材質的紋理，暖棕色調，真實不刻意整理的工作痕跡，職人紀實感。
prompts.en: Craft studio scene: tools, materials and work-in-progress scattered across the bench, the maker’s hands shaping {{piece}}, side window light revealing shavings and material texture, warm brown palette, honest untidied traces of work, artisan documentary feel.

prompts.zh: 廟口小吃街夜景：廟宇燈火在街尾發亮，兩側攤販的招牌與蒸氣交錯，人潮川流不息，暖黃燈泡與紅色招牌構成主色，高 ISO 顆粒與輕微動態模糊，濃厚的台灣夜生活氣味。
prompts.en: Temple-front food street at night: the temple glowing at the end of the lane, vendor signage and steam on both sides, a constant flow of people, warm bulbs and red signboards dominating, high-ISO grain and slight motion blur, the unmistakable air of Taiwanese night life.

prompts.zh: 老屋改造咖啡廳：磨石子地板與檜木窗框，斑駁的白牆與舊式鐵花窗，午後陽光透過窗格在地上投出幾何光影，木桌上有一杯咖啡，低飽和暖色調，安靜的時光感。
prompts.en: Old-house cafe: terrazzo floor and cypress window frames, weathered white walls and iron grilles, afternoon sun through the lattice casting geometric shadows on the floor, a cup of coffee on a wooden table, muted warm palette, a sense of suspended time.

prompts.zh: 台灣城鎮鐵皮屋景觀：層疊加蓋的鐵皮屋頂與水塔在午後強光下泛出鏽紅與藍綠，交錯的電線切割天空，遠處是青山，高空俯視構圖，飽和真實的色彩，帶感情的紀實視角。
prompts.en: Taiwanese corrugated-roof townscape: layers of tin roofs and water tanks glowing rust-red and blue-green in hard afternoon light, tangled power lines cutting the sky, green hills beyond, elevated overhead view, saturated honest color, an affectionate documentary eye.

prompts.zh: 高山茶園清晨：整齊的茶樹沿等高線環繞山坡形成流暢曲線，晨霧在谷地流動，採茶人的身影點綴其中，斜射的晨光讓茶葉泛出嫩綠，層次分明的遠山，寬幅構圖。
prompts.en: High-mountain tea plantation at dawn: tea bushes following the contours in flowing curves, mist drifting through the valley, tea pickers dotting the slope, low morning light making the leaves glow fresh green, layered ridgelines beyond, wide composition.

prompts.zh: 水田倒影：插秧不久的水田映出天空與雲，幾隻白鷺鷥立於水中，遠處是三合院與檳榔樹的剪影，清晨的柔和光線與薄霧，低飽和的青綠與天藍，安靜遼闊的農村景致。
prompts.en: Flooded paddy reflection: newly transplanted rice fields mirroring the sky and clouds, egrets standing in the shallows, a courtyard house and betel palms silhouetted beyond, soft misty morning light, muted green and sky blue, quiet expansive countryside.

prompts.zh: 海岸燈塔黃昏：白色燈塔立於礁岩上，天空由橘紅漸層到深藍，海浪拍擊岩石被長曝抹成霧白，遠方漁船的燈點綴，冷暖強烈對比，遼闊而孤獨的海岸氣息。
prompts.en: Coastal lighthouse at dusk: a white tower on volcanic rock, sky graduating from orange-red to deep blue, waves against the rocks smoothed to mist by long exposure, distant fishing boat lights, strong warm-cool contrast, vast and solitary.

prompts.zh: 老電影院外觀：斑駁的手繪看板與霓虹燈管招牌，磨石子外牆與舊式售票口，黃昏時燈光剛亮起，街上停著幾輛機車，褪色的紅藍配色，懷舊而略帶蕭條的氛圍。
prompts.en: Old cinema facade: a weathered hand-painted billboard and neon tube signage, terrazzo walls and a vintage ticket window, lights just coming on at dusk, a few scooters parked outside, faded red and blue palette, nostalgic with a hint of decline.

prompts.zh: 眷村巷弄：低矮的紅磚與水泥平房，門前有盆栽與竹竿曬衣，牆上有褪色的標語，狹窄巷道延伸出縱深，午後斜光在牆面切出明暗，溫暖的懷舊色調，濃厚的生活痕跡。
prompts.en: Military dependants’ village alley: low brick and concrete houses, potted plants and laundry poles by the doors, faded slogans on the walls, a narrow lane receding in perspective, late light dividing the wall into light and shade, warm nostalgic grade, dense traces of daily life.

prompts.zh: 鹽田夕照：規整的方格鹽田在夕陽下映出粉橘與淡紫的天空倒影，堆起的鹽山形成白色三角，工作者的剪影行走其間，空拍或低角度廣角，幾何秩序與柔和色彩並存。
prompts.en: Salt flats at sunset: a grid of evaporation ponds mirroring a pink and violet sky, mounded salt forming white triangles, a worker’s silhouette walking between them, aerial or low wide angle, geometric order set against soft color.

prompts.zh: 鐵道平交道日常：柵欄放下，機車與行人在兩側等待，遠方列車正駛近並帶出輕微動態模糊，兩旁是老式街屋與招牌，午後的暖光與長影，飽和的紀實色彩，濃厚的台灣街景感。
prompts.en: Level crossing moment: the barrier down, scooters and pedestrians waiting on both sides, a train approaching in the distance with slight motion blur, old shophouses and signage lining the track, warm late light and long shadows, saturated documentary color, unmistakably Taiwanese.

modes.d: 人像換風格、換場景、換服裝
modes.zh: 以我上傳的照片為基準，完整保留照片中人物的臉部特徵、五官比例、膚色與髮型，長相必須一致、可辨識為同一人。忽略下方描述中關於年齡、性別與外貌的設定，只採用其中的服裝、光線、場景與風格。
modes.en: Use my uploaded photo as the base. Preserve the subject’s facial features, proportions, skin tone and hairstyle exactly — the person must remain recognizably the same. Ignore any age, gender or appearance details below; apply only the wardrobe, lighting, setting and style described.

modes.zh: 以我上傳的照片中的物件為主體，完整保留其外型、比例、顏色、材質與標籤文字，不要更動物件本身。只依下方描述更換背景、光線與擺設情境。
modes.en: Use the object in my uploaded photo as the subject. Preserve its shape, proportions, color, material and any label text exactly — do not alter the object itself. Change only the background, lighting and staging as described below.

modes.d: 把照片轉成插畫、油畫等
modes.zh: 將我上傳的照片轉繪成下列風格。保留原始構圖、主要元素的位置與人物姿態，只改變畫風、筆觸與色彩表現。
modes.en: Reinterpret my uploaded photo in the style described below. Keep the original composition, the placement of the main elements and the subject’s pose; change only the rendering style, mark-making and color treatment.

modes.d: 只改一個地方，其餘不動

modes.en: Modify only the area I specify. Everything else must match the original exactly, including composition, lighting direction and color. The change to make:
